i18n/scientists-profiles.json:36 Aytekin Huseynli — L272, L003, L235/profiles/1/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Aytekin Huseynli is an international specialist in social policy, social work, child and family welfare. Dr. Huseynli is an assistant professor at the University of Washington. Her applied research focuses on the formulation of social policies, especially the improvement of family and child welfare. Aytekin Huseynli also explores strategies and ways to channel natural resource revenues into social development in countries rich in oil, gas and minerals. Aytekin Huseynli&#x27;s doctoral dissertation led to the creation of the National Children&#x27;s Fund state program, which covers 7 million children in Kazakhstan and is financed by a portion of the oil and gas wealth.</p><p class="bio">She is the author of 3 chapters in 3 books in the field of social policy, social work and social development, 15 scientific articles in 15 international scientific journals, and more than 20 publications, and she is a member of the editorial boards of 2 scientific journals in the field of social development, social policy and social work. She gave presentations at more than 20 international scientific conferences and received 2 international awards for her scientific work. She was the scientific supervisor of more than 10 students. Aytekin Huseynli teaches social research, statistics, program evaluation and social policy. Currently, she is the head of several research projects.</p><p class="bio">A pioneer in her field, Aytekin Huseynli is one of the first professional social workers who received an education in the field of social work in the post-Soviet region and is one of the founders of the social work profession and education in Azerbaijan. She is the founder of the "Azerbaijan Social Work" Public Union, which represents Azerbaijan in the field of international and regional social development.</p><p class="bio">She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Global Program at the Brown School of the University of Washington, the deputy director of international programs at the Center for Social Development, and an associate professor at the Center for Child Abuse Research, Training and Education. At the global level, Aytekin Huseynli is a research and statistics specialist for Eurasia at UNICEF and a member of the Research Committee of the International Association of Schools of Social Work.</p>

After

<p class="bio bio-lead">Research Professor, Institute of Soft Matter, Theoretical Physics II, HHU, Düsseldorf; Professor, Department of Theoretical Physics, Institute of High Temperatures, Russian Academy of Sciences, Moscow</p><p class="bio">More than 200 scientific articles have been published in about 40 scientific journals. He has participated in about 100 scientific conferences.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Research interests:</p><p class="bio">Morphological changes of proton-conducting ionomers, conductivity of ionomers, development of water-free conductive nanocomposite ionomers.</p><p class="bio">Actuation of elastomer composites, electrostriction effects in dipole systems, development of nanocomposites with mobility in application areas.</p><p class="bio">Colloid physics, theory of effective interaction potential in electrolytes, phase transition in charged systems, liquid-crystal nucleation processes, critical electrolytes in nanopores.</p><p class="bio">Correlation effects in many-body systems, DNA-DNA condensation effects, protein-DNA interactions.</p><p class="bio">Nucleation processes and template-controlled phase transition in dusty plasma systems.</p><p class="bio">Liquid crystals on curved surfaces, defect-defect interactions, field-dependent morphologies.</p><p class="bio">New composite materials for energy storage applications, Coulomb correlation effects for induced dipoles.</p><p class="bio">Applications of artificial intelligence and deep learning in materials research.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:87 Sevinj Mammadova — L007, L227, L236, L263/profiles/4/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Sevinj Mammadova is a very experienced specialist in the field of education policy. She specializes in the development and implementation of strategies aimed at improving education systems. Sevinj Mammadova has led large-scale international projects to increase the quality and accessibility of education and ensure that every person who wants to study gets equal opportunities, resources and support, regardless of their background, socioeconomic status, gender, ethnicity and other factors. Her work aims to make education systems more effective and align them more closely with national priorities.</p><p class="bio">Sevinj Mammadova has extensive skills in managing large-scale projects, ensuring efficient use of resources, and making important decisions that improve educational outcomes. She also works extensively to establish global partnerships, adapt educational programs to the needs of the country, and implement educational reforms based on scientific research.</p><p class="bio">Sevinj Mammadova also has extensive experience in the field of financial management for educational programs. She involves key stakeholders such as teachers, students and government representatives in the decision-making process and actively participates in defining long-term educational goals.</p><p class="bio">Sevinj Mammadova holds a Ph.D. in educational management and strategies, which further strengthens her ability to lead and recommend educational reforms. She also plays an important role in shaping educational strategies and practices at the international level, contributing to better educational outcomes worldwide.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;International Graduate of the Month&quot; award of the US State Department – February 2013</li><li>University of Texas, Arlington – "University Scholar" – November 2009</li><li>US Department of State – Edmund S. Muskie Graduate Fellowship – April 2008</li><li>US State Department – Undergraduate UGRAD Scholarship – July 2005.</li></ul></div>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:138 Messoud Efendiyev — L264, L265/profiles/7/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Head of the &quot;Dynamic Systems&quot; Department at the &quot;Helmholtz&quot; Scientific Research Center, Munich, Germany</p><p class="bio">Rector&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor at Marmara University, Istanbul, Turkey</p><p class="bio">Professor Masud Efendiyev is the first Azerbaijani scientist living abroad, known both for the prestigious international awards he won and the international conferences organized in his honor. Although he has been living and working in Germany for more than 35 years, he remains a citizen of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Contributions to nonlinear analysis and mathematical physics</p><p class="bio">He created a new theory of topological invariants for the global solution of nonlinear equations.</p><p class="bio">These invariants play an important role in the analysis of qualitative changes (local and global bifurcation) of nonlinear systems.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Mathematical modeling</p><p class="bio">He conducted fundamental research on mathematical modeling of problems encountered in the fields of biology, medicine, ecology, mechanics and physics.</p><p class="bio">He created new classes of attractors of dynamic systems according to evolution equations and made an important contribution to their systematic study.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international scientific journals</p><p class="bio">He is a member of the editorial boards of more than ten leading international journals.</p><p class="bio">He is the editor-in-chief of "International Journal of Biomathematics and Biostatistics."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific publications</p><p class="bio">He is the author of 8 books published in Japan, Germany, the USA, Canada and Switzerland.</p><p class="bio">He has written more than 200 scientific articles and collaborated with co-authors from 15 countries.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international universities</p><p class="bio">In 2018, he lectured for 6 months at the University of Toronto and the Fields Institute as a &quot;Dean&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor&quot; and played an important role in the implementation of the thematic program "Emerging Challenges in Mathematical Biology."</p><p class="bio">In 2019, he was invited to the University of Waterloo as a "James D. Murray Distinguished Visiting Professor."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honors</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>In 1991, he was the first Azerbaijani scientist to win the &quot;Alexander von Humboldt&quot; award established by the German government.</li><li>In 2005, he was awarded the prestigious &quot;Japan Society for the Promotion of Science - JSPS&quot; award.</li><li>In 2007, he won the prestigious &quot;Otto Monsted&quot; award of the Danish government. He is the first Azerbaijani scientist to win these awards.</li><li>In 2022, he was awarded the honorary title of Honored Scientist by the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliyev.</li><li>In 2023, he was awarded the Life Achievement Award of the Fields Institute.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">International conferences and recognition</p><p class="bio">The 60th anniversary of teacher Masud was celebrated in Germany (Munich), and the 70th anniversary was celebrated in Baku (at the state level) with international scientific conferences.</p><p class="bio">75 leading scientists from 25 countries participated in the conference held in Munich.</p><p class="bio">55 famous scientists from 23 countries participated in the conference held in Baku.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">With the support of the "2007–2015 State Program for the Education of Azerbaijani Youth in Foreign Countries," he completed his doctorate with honors at the Mannheim Medical Faculty of Heidelberg University. His main research focus is the creation of complex 3D cell cultures in vitro for the study of tumor diseases and the investigation of the effect of tumor cells on drugs in those cultures through various biomarkers. The findings of this research have been published in two peer-reviewed articles so far. The most recent article was well received by the journal &quot;Frontiers in Oncology&quot; and republished in a special issue. In addition, the program he wrote for the segmentation of large-volume confocal microscopic images is currently in the process of being registered as an invention. As a group leader, he supervises 2 master's students and 1 doctoral student.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:257 Khadija Zeynalova — L273, L019/profiles/14/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">She is the first Azerbaijani composer and musicologist to be awarded a doctoral scholarship by the prestigious &quot;Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung&quot; in Germany. In addition, she is a recipient of the &quot;DAAD&quot; scholarship award, the scholarship award of the German Ministry of Culture of North Rhine-Westphalia, the scholarship award of the &quot;GVL&quot; Foundation, the scholarship awards of the &quot;GEMA&quot; foundation and the &quot;Musikfonds&quot; foundation.</p><p class="bio">In 2020, Khadija Zeynalova was awarded the Letter of Appreciation of the Republic of Azerbaijan "for her special activity in Diaspora building."</p><p class="bio">In 2021, she was awarded the &quot;880th anniversary of Nizamin&quot; medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">In 2021, in the Year of Nizami and Yunus Emre, she was awarded a Certificate of Appreciation for her participation as a composer in the &quot;Masterpieces of the Turkish World&quot; project organized by TURKSOY.</p><p class="bio">In 2022, at the 5th Congress of the World Azerbaijanis held in Shusha, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan "For Service in Diaspora Activity."</p><p class="bio">In 2024, as the first Azerbaijani composer in Germany, she was awarded the nomination &quot;Composer and Artist of the Year&quot; by the German Ministry of Culture and "Klosterlandschaft OWL."</p><p class="bio">Khadija Zeynalova was awarded the Honorary Decree for her contribution to the promotion of Azerbaijani musical culture in the world as a composer at the 1st Forum of Azerbaijani Culture Ambassadors held in Antalya on November 3–5, 2025.</p><p class="bio">She is the author of a doctoral dissertation on musicology and art studies, 1 scientific book published in Germany in the field of composition, 35 books published in Azerbaijan, Holland, Japan, England and Germany, and 10 articles published in scientific journals. She has given research presentations as a composer and musicologist at 20 international scientific conferences, and is the author and artistic director of about 20 different international projects, festivals, and concerts.</p><p class="bio">She was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal in 2026 by the Decree of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mr. Ilham Aliyev for her services in the field of strengthening friendship between peoples and the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Azerbaijan ETN Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnologies in Baku, group leader and laboratory manager</p><p class="bio-section-title">Research areas:</p><p class="bio">Prof. Dr. Garib Murshudov is one of the world&#x27;s leading scientists in the field of molecular biology, crystallography and structural biology. His main research directions are as follows:</p><p class="bio">Macromolecular crystallography and structural biology (analysis of three-dimensional structures of proteins and nucleic acids).</p><p class="bio">Cryo-electron microscopy (Cryo-EM) and bioinformatics (molecular modeling, structural analysis and data processing).</p><p class="bio">Statistical and mathematical modeling (application of maximum likelihood and Bayesian statistical methods in biological systems).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Academic and professional experience:</p><p class="bio">He works as a group leader at the MRC Molecular Biology Laboratory (Cambridge, Great Britain) and as a laboratory manager at the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnology of the Ministry of Science and Education of Azerbaijan (Baku).</p><p class="bio">He worked in prestigious research institutes and universities in Great Britain, Russia and Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">He is the main author of the software that constructs atomic models of macromolecules using experiments, renders them transparent and checks them statistically (REFMAC, BALBES, Servalcat, AceDRG, etc.).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and recognition:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>He was awarded the honorary title of &quot;Honored Scientist&quot; of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li><li>Won the Wellcome Trust Senior Fellowship—the UK's most prestigious fellowship in biology</li><li>Member of the European Molecular Biology Organization (EMBO).</li><li>Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society of Great Britain.</li><li>Member of the CCP4 executive committee – this committee brings together leading international researchers in the field of computational structural biology.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">Publications and scientific contributions:</p><p class="bio">He is the author of more than 120 high-impact scientific articles, including in prestigious journals such as Nature, Science, PNAS and Acta Crystallographica.</p><p class="bio">He was a leading researcher in the development of innovative software (REFMAC5, SERVALCAT, EMDA, BALBES, AceDRG) for the analysis and modeling of molecular structures.</p><p class="bio">He regularly participates in international symposia and conferences and organizes scientific seminars in different countries (Great Britain, Japan, China, USA, Brazil, India, etc.).</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:376 Vehid Geruslu — L030, L231/profiles/21/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Dr. Vahid Garousi works in two professional roles: as an IT specialist and an IT professor. Since 1998 he has provided consulting and training to international IT companies in software engineering, testing and QA, and he is also a professor of software engineering at Queen&#x27;s University in Belfast, United Kingdom. At the same time, he serves as a part-time software test strategist and team leader at ProSys LLC in Azerbaijan and Testinium A.Ş. in Turkey. His name is written in English as Vahid Garousi.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi earned his Ph.D. in software engineering from Carleton University in Canada in 2006 and his master&#x27;s degree from the University of Waterloo in Canada in 2003. Over more than 25 years of IT experience, he served as the lead test and QA consultant for the United Kingdom&#x27;s COVID mobile application in 2020–2021, as a test consultant for one of the UK&#x27;s major banks in 2022, and as the lead test and QA consultant at HAVELSAN in Turkey from 2012 to 2019.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi is a professor of software engineering at Queen&#x27;s University in Belfast, United Kingdom. Previously he held associate professor positions in the Netherlands (2017–2019), Turkey (2015–2017) and Canada (2001–2014). He received his Ph.D. in software engineering from Carleton University in Canada in 2006. His research areas are software engineering, software testing, empirical studies, action research and industry–academia collaboration. In parallel with his academic career, he is a practicing consultant and trainer in software engineering, delivering consulting and corporate training across various areas including software engineering, testing and quality assurance, model-driven development and software maintenance.</p><p class="bio">In a bibliometric study published in the Journal of Systems and Software in 2018, Dr. Garousi was ranked the 8th most active mid-career software engineering researcher in the world, out of more than 4,000 active researchers. Dr. Garousi has published more than 150 papers to date. He was selected as a Distinguished Speaker by the IEEE Computer Society in 2012–2015. He is also a member of the IEEE and the IEEE Computer Society and a licensed professional engineer (PEng) in Alberta, Canada.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi has been the principal investigator of several research projects and has launched many significant R&amp;D software engineering projects together with software companies in several countries, including Canada and Turkey. He has served as an organizer and program committee member at many international conferences, such as ICST, ICSP, CSEE&amp;T, MoDELS and the Turkish National Software Engineering Conference. Among the awards he has received is the Alberta Ingenuity New Faculty Award, which he won in 2007.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific achievements and recognition:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>According to the bibliometric study published in &quot;Journal of Systems and Software&quot; in 2018, Dr. Garuslu is rated as the 8th most active mid-career software engineering researcher worldwide (out of over 4,000 active researchers).</li><li>He is the author of more than 150 scientific articles and has made extensive academic contributions (PEng) in Alberta, Canada.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">More information:</p><ul class="bullets profile-links"><li><a href="http://www.vgarousi.com" target="_blank" i18n/scientists-profiles.json:393 Khagani Gayibli — L232/profiles/22/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli is a poet, translator, scholar and public figure. In addition to his extensive research in Azerbaijani literature, linguistics and journalism, he is also known internationally for diaspora activity and academic cooperation. With his scientific work "Comparison of Verb Structures in Estonian and Turkish Languages," he is the first Azerbaijani scholar to investigate kinship relations between Finno-Ugric and Turkic-Tatar languages in world linguistics.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Main research areas</p><p class="bio-section-title">Turkology and linguistics:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Comparison of Verb Structures in Estonian and Turkish Languages&quot;</li><li>&quot;Linguistic relations and structural differences between Turkish and Estonian&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Political and cultural relations:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Political and cultural relations between Estonia and the Turkic World&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Journalism and visual media:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;The importance of photography in the print media&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honorary titles:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Progress&quot; medal (2022) – awarded by the President of Azerbaijan for his contribution to the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</li><li>&quot;Golden Star Medal&quot; (2024) – awarded by the International Academy of Sciences for Turkic World Studies of the Republic of Turkey.</li><li>Medal &quot;For service in diaspora activity&quot; (2024) – presented by the State Committee on Work with Diaspora of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Publications and literary activity:</p><p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli is the author of both scholarly and journalistic articles and works of poetry and prose. His works have been translated into Estonian, Georgian, Russian, Latvian, German, English and Turkic languages.</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>Author of more than 40 sociopolitical, historical and scientific-cultural articles;</li><li>author of 6 books and 1 monograph;</li><li>author of 4 scientific articles published in 2 scientific journals;</li><li>speaker and participant at more than 20 international symposia and conferences.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Professional and academic activity:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>Finno-Ugric and Turkic Peoples Research Center – chairman</li><li>University of Tartu (Estonia) – director of the Turkish Language Center</li><li>World Congress of Azerbaijanis – member of the Board, deputy chairman</li><li>Estonian-Azerbaijani Society – chairman</li><li>World Association of Azerbaijani Scientists – member of the Organizing Committee</li><li>Azerbaijan Writers&#x27; Union – member</li><li>Estonian Society of Academic Orientalists – member</li><li>Turkish Literature Foundation – honorary member</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Diplomatic and translation activity:</p><p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli has participated as a translator in high-level official meetings in Estonia and Turkey. He served as a special interpreter during official visits by the presidents, parliament speakers and ministers of Azerbaijan, Turkey and Estonia.</p>

After

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:414 Aynur Guliyeva — L033/profiles/23/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">In 2019, she obtained a Ph.D. degree in materials chemistry from the University of Orleans, France. Her research areas include structure-property relations of polymer materials, nanostructuring, preparation of functional materials and application of these fields in modern technologies. She collaborated with numerous international laboratories and conducted postdoctoral research at the French ENSAM/PIMM laboratory and the University of Delaware in the United States. Aynur Guliyeva also has industrial experience; she worked as a project manager for medicinal capsules for 2 years at Capsugel, which is part of the Lonza company. She currently works as an assistant professor at the university. Alongside her teaching, she has established a research group on "smart polymer materials" and conducts research in this field. She also performs various teaching and administrative duties at the university and mentors female scientists to support their professional development. Aynur Guliyeva has a number of scientific articles and has made oral and poster presentations at international conferences.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:431 Gunel Safarova — L240/profiles/24/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">For 7 years, she worked as the head of scientific research and educational projects between the French University of Versailles (Université de Versailles – Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines) and Georgetown University in the US. Currently, she works as a manager-consultant at the international consulting company Onepoint. She lectures on "Project Management," "Change Management" and "Leadership" to MBA students at Versailles University of France and ADA University of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">She has given presentations at many international scientific conferences and seminars in different countries. As an associate researcher, she served on the organizing committee of international scientific conferences organized by the LAREQUOI scientific laboratory. She is the author of several scholarly and journalistic articles. Articles about Azerbaijan were published in the French-language press. She supervises the theses of approximately 10–15 MBA and MSc students each year. Since 2019, she has been the first Azerbaijani representative of the Young Ambassadors Association of France. Since 2020, she has been the coordinator of the French Institute of Academic Studies for Central Asian countries. In 2020, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan "For service in the Diaspora activity."</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:448 Reyhan Hasanova — L241/profiles/25/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Reyhan Hasanova, who initially trained as a medical biologist, later earned two master's degrees in molecular biology and genetics in France. After that, she earned her doctorate in medical sciences on the topic of "biomarker research in colon cancer." She currently works as a research consultant on oncology and rare diseases in the Life Sciences department of Oracle in Paris, one of the world's largest companies. Through projects in this field, it is possible to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and cost of drugs and treatments, and to complete clinical trials by providing insights into how treatments are implemented in daily clinical practice. The results of these projects are published in international scientific journals and presented at conferences. The company she works for cooperates with up to 200 different pharmaceutical and biotechnological companies.</p>

After

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">She is the author of 2 books and 8 scientific articles in the field of economics. She gave research presentations at 12 international scientific conferences. Her articles have been published in local and international scientific journals.</p><p class="bio">She was a member of the Board of Directors of the International Black Sea University, and worked as an internal expert on dissertations and scientific works of doctoral students (Ph.D.). She also supervised the scientific works of master&#x27;s students at that university.</p><p class="bio">As the director of the "Maarif" organization, she implements various projects addressing the educational needs of Georgian Azerbaijanis. These events were an important platform for discussing the problems of Azerbaijani-speaking schools, strengthening cooperation between teachers and improving the quality of education.</p><p class="bio">Her activity is of great importance in terms of protecting the national-cultural identity and mother tongue of Azerbaijanis living in Georgia.</p><p class="bio">In 2013, she was awarded the &quot;Honor&quot; medal by the "Borchalı" Public Union for her achievements in science. In 2020, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan by the State Committee on Diaspora Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan for her services to the community, as well as for her contributions to the preservation of the Azerbaijani language and culture.</p><p class="bio">She was a participant in the 5th Congress of the World Azerbaijanis—the Victory Congress—held in the city of Shusha.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:482 Lev Eppelbaum — L039/profiles/27/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Honorary professor of Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University</p><p class="bio">Professor Lev Eppelbaum (Tel Aviv University, Department of Geophysics) is the author of approximately 460 scientific publications. These include 12 books, 18 book chapters, 194 peer-reviewed journal articles, 81 conference materials and 171 abstracts published by international scientific publishers (Kluwer Academic Publisher, Springer, Elsevier, Chapman and Hall, Institute of Physics (Great Britain)). Prof. Eppelbaum&#x27;s main research areas are geodynamics and tectonic reconstructions, applied and environmental geophysics, archaeological geophysics, and integrated analysis of geophysical, geological and related data.</p><p class="bio">He was elected head of scientific departments 26 times at international conferences. Professor Lev Eppelbaum is the editor-in-chief of the journal "Geology, Geophysics, and Earth Sciences" and a member of the editorial boards of such prestigious journals as "Positioning," "Open Petroleum Engineering Journal," "Archaeological Discovery," "Stratigraphy, Petroleum, Sedimentology, Geochemistry," "ANAS Transactions, Earth Sciences," "International Journal of Earthquake Engineering," "Discover Geoscience," "Academy Green Energy," "Contributions to Geosciences," "Geosciences," "Russian Journal of Physical Chemistry," and "World Journal of Physics." At the same time, he served as a guest editor for the journals "Advances in Geosciences," "Journal of Geophysics and Engineering," "Continent and Life Evolution," "Frontiers in Earth Sciences," "Geosciences (Switzerland)," &quot;Land&quot; and "Applied Sciences (Switzerland)."</p><p class="bio">Professor Lev Eppelbaum is a member of two international geophysical commissions: the "Rotation of the Earth" commission and "WebmedCentral Ecology Advisory Board."</p><p class="bio">In 2020, he was awarded the title of honorary professor of the Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University, and in 2023, he was elected a foreign member of the Georgian Academy of Sciences.</p><p class="bio">Professor Eppelbaum has received several awards; among them is the Christian Huygens medal of the European Geosciences Union (2019).</p><p class="bio">According to Google Scholar, his scholarly publications have been cited nearly 8,000 times.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Mark Applebaum is the author of 16 books and more than 90 articles published in scientific journals and conference proceedings in English, Hebrew, Russian, Spanish, Arabic, Ukrainian and Polish. His research interests include popularizing mathematics, teaching mathematics to gifted children, developing creative and critical thinking, and developing STEM education.</p><p class="bio">During his academic career, Professor M. Applebaum spoke at more than 30 international conferences and often acted as a keynote speaker and a member of scientific committees. In 2022, he was elected to the International Committee of the International Mathematical Creativity and Talent Group (IGMCG) and the Education Committee of the European Mathematical Society (EMS). Since 2023, Kaye has been serving as the head of the Master&#x27;s Program in Integrative STEM Education at the College of Education.</p><p class="bio">During the last 15 years, Professor M. Applebaum has participated as an invited speaker in various academic events held in universities and schools of Azerbaijan. These institutions include Baku State University (BSU), Baku branch of Moscow State University (MSU), Azerbaijan Language University, Azerbaijan State University of Architecture and Construction, school number 134 and other educational institutions.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:516 Saadat Karimi — L042/profiles/29/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Boras University, associate professor, university lecturer, course leader</p><p class="bio">She worked in these positions until 2021 at the Universities of Gothenburg, Stockholm and Umea. She is a researcher at the joint SONOMA scientific center of these universities.</p><p class="bio">In 1999, she defended her dissertation at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics of ANAS in Baku in order to obtain the degree of candidate of sciences. In 2000, she approved her dissertation in Sweden and started working as a postdoctoral fellow at Umea University. She is the author or co-author of 20 articles in this field in 10 scientific journals. In 2006, she defended her new dissertation at Gothenburg University. She is also a specialist in didactics of mathematics. 12 articles have been published in this field. She defended her dissertation on language and philology, and has a master&#x27;s degree. She is a specialist in Russian, English, and Swedish and sociologically oriented philology. She has about 100 articles in this field. She has given presentations at 50 international scientific conferences. Scientific supervision of 1 doctoral, 20 master&#x27;s and 60 master&#x27;s works on mathematics didactics, 5 Ph.D. theses were defended.</p><p class="bio">Since 2000, she has been a member of the Board of Directors of the Azerbaijan Federation (AFI), which operates in Sweden. She is the head of the organization "Gobustan-Azerbaijan Aydınlar Ocağı."</p><p class="bio">In 2022, for her contribution to the promotion of the Azerbaijani language and culture in foreign countries, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan &quot;For service in Diaspora activity&quot; by the State Committee for Work with Diaspora.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:601 Yulduz Rahimov — L049, L267/profiles/34/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">He is an expert in operations research and mathematical modeling. In 1981, he defended his Ph.D. thesis on applied mathematics at the Computing Center of the Academy of Sciences of the former USSR (Moscow). In 1991, he was awarded the diploma of Senior Researcher in the field of Application of Computing Techniques, Mathematical Modeling and Mathematical Methods in Research. From 1999 to 2024, he taught more than 25 different Ph.D., master&#x27;s and bachelor&#x27;s courses at York and Toronto Universities in Canada. More than 25 articles have been published in various international scientific journals. He is the author of a textbook and a book. He gave presentations at 12 international scientific conferences held in the USA, Canada, Australia, Italy, China and Russia. He gave speeches at the scientific seminars of the Institute of Cybernetics of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences, Fields Institute of Mathematical Research of Canada, Toronto and York Universities and ADA University. In 2008, he served on the Analysis Committee of the International Conference on Computational Intelligence in Modeling, Control and Automation held in Vienna (Austria). He was a member of the program committees of INFOCOMP 2013 (Lisbon, Portugal) and INFOCOMP 2015 (Brussels, Belgium) international conferences. His work is referenced in two high school textbooks. In 2013, he was awarded the Excellence in Teaching Award by the Faculty of Science at the University of York – an award given to him for teaching excellence and service to the faculty. Together with Professor Robert G. Burns, he translated the works of N. N. Moiseyev, a former academician of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR, &quot;Man and the Noosphere&quot; and &quot;How Far Tomorrow is&quot; into English. The translation of the latter book was published by Birkhauser publishing house in 2022.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:618 Rovshan Ibrahimov — L051/profiles/35/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Rovshan Ibrahimov worked as a professor in the field of international relations and energy policy at various universities in Azerbaijan, Turkey, Germany, Poland, Kazakhstan and South Korea, and currently works as a professor at Hankuk University of Foreign Languages (HUFS) and Khazar University.</p><p class="bio">He was honored for his activities in the field of foreign policy analysis, international relations and diaspora at the Center for Strategic Studies under the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">Professor R. Ibrahimov has received scholarships and scientific awards from prestigious institutions such as Oxford University, Soros Foundation, Sasakawa Foundation and Cold War Research Program. He is the author of more than 200 scientific articles in the field of energy security, foreign policy and international relations.</p><p class="bio">In 2024, the book &quot;Foreign Policy of Small States: South Caucasus States in the Modern World and Beyond&quot; was published. His articles have been published by international publishers and research institutes such as "Springer Nature Switzerland," &quot;Routledge&quot; and "Caspian Report."</p><p class="bio">He regularly makes speeches at scientific conferences and summits on international energy and geopolitics topics. Prof. Dr. Rovshan Ibrahimov is one of the leading experts in the field of energy diplomacy and foreign policy of Azerbaijan and has extensive academic experience and a rich scientific research portfolio. He is distinguished by his active participation in international strategic discussions.</p><p class="bio">At the same time, he worked as the head of the Department of International Relations, vice-rector for International Relations and head of the department at Qafqaz University.</p><p class="bio">The scientist is a member of the editorial boards of international scientific journals and makes scientific contributions to various think tanks. In 2024, he was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan &quot;For services in diaspora activities&quot; for his activities in the field of international relations and diaspora.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:652 Seymur Nasirov — L054, L233, L245/profiles/37/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">A teacher of Azerbaijani language and literature at the Faculty of Literature of Cairo University, a scientific leader at the department of Oriental languages and Arabic, president of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Peoples&#x27; Friendship Academy, adviser on foreign relations of the General Secretariat of the World Fatwa Organizations, chairman of the Board of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Friendship Society, head of the Azerbaijani Diaspora in Egypt.</p><p class="bio">Since the 2016–2017 academic year, he has been working as a teacher of the Azerbaijani language at the Faculty of Literature of Cairo University, Egypt, and as a scientific supervisor at the department of Oriental Languages and Arabic Language of the faculty. By 2026, he had taught the Azerbaijani language to more than 1,700 Egyptians.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Public and professional activities:</p><ul class="bullets"><li>Founder and president of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Peoples&#x27; Friendship Academy</li><li>Adviser on foreign relations of the General Secretariat of the World Fatwa Institutions</li><li>Chairman of the Board of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Friendship Society</li><li>Head of the Azerbaijani Diaspora in Egypt</li><li>Executive Director of Halga Foundation</li><li>Coordinator of Egypt-Azerbaijan inter-parliamentary friendship group.</li><li>Since 2003, he has led thousands of students from more than 100 countries who came to study in Egypt, and through them he is promoting the truths of Azerbaijan in the world. Currently (in 2025), he is leading more than 2,000 students from 65 countries studying in Egypt.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific and research activities:</p><p class="bio">For more than 25 years, he has been conducting research on Azerbaijan in Arabic sources. As a result of these studies, he wrote two books in Arabic about more than 250 Azerbaijani scientists.</p><p class="bio">The work &quot;Azerbaijani scientists and writers in Arabic sources&quot; was published in the Azerbaijani language in 2022.</p><p class="bio">He discovered manuscripts of hundreds of Azerbaijani scientists in Egyptian libraries and studied them.</p><p class="bio">More than 15 scientific and journalistic articles were published in Arabic and Azerbaijani languages in prestigious magazines of Arab countries and Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio-section-title">International activity:</p><p class="bio">He participated in more than 20 international conferences held in different countries of the world and made speeches on scientific and cultural topics related to Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>In 2017, by order of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Mr. Ilham Aliyev, he was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal for his services in the field of strengthening friendship between peoples and the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora;</li><li>On July 18, 2018, he was awarded the medal of the Egyptian Ministry of Education for his exceptional services in the development of cultural and scientific relations between Egypt and Azerbaijan;</li><li>In 2019, he was honored by the Embassy of Uzbekistan in Egypt for his support to the Uzbek Diaspora living in Egypt;</li><li>In 2019, he was honored by the Trade Union of Seyids in Egypt for his exceptional services in the development of relations between Egypt and Azerbaijan;</li><li>In 2020, he was awarded the medal &quot;For service in diaspora activity&quot; for his great contributions to the diaspora policy of our country;</li><li>In 2024, he received an honorary award from the Union of Arab Countries Students studying at al-Azhar University;</li><li>In 2024, by order of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Mr. Ilham Aliyev, he was awarded the &quot;100th anniversary of Heydar Aliyev&quot; (1923–2023) jubilee medal for his services in implementing the idea of Azerbaijanism and strengthening the solidarity of Azerbaijanis of the world.</li><li>On September 3, 2025, he was awarded the first-class "Science and Sciences" order by the President of Egypt, Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi. Seymur Nasirov is the first person to be awarded this order among foreigners living in Egypt.</li><li>On October 1, 2025, he was awarded the medal of the Ministry of Education of Egypt for his services in the development of scientific and cultural relations between the Arab Republic of Egypt and the Republic of Azerbaijan and was awarded a letter of appreciation by the Egyptian Cultural Center in Baku.</li><li>On December 16, 2025, he was honored by the Mufti of Egypt and Chairman of the General Secretariat of the World Fatwa Houses and Institutions Prof. Nazir Muhammad Eyyad for his great contributions to religious and intellectual work, as well as for his efforts in promoting the values of tolerance, moderation and intercultural dialogue, with the participation of muftis and great scholars from 50 countries of the world.</li><li>On March 17, 2026, he was awarded the &quot;Seal of the Prophet&quot; order in Egypt for his effective work in the field of service to science and knowledge, promotion of the values of tolerance, and important contributions to the strengthening of friendly relations between nations.</li></ul></div><div class="card-resources"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="seymur-nasirov-media.html">Additional resources <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></a></div>

She took part in the implementation of the following two large-scale concert programs:</p><p class="bio">• May 31, 2024 – a concert program called "Cradle of Eastern Culture," held in Shusha for an audience of about 250 people.</p><p class="bio">• May 30, 2025 – a concert program dedicated to Oman–Azerbaijan friendship and organized for an audience of about 300 people.</p><p class="bio">Articles about Dr Saida Khalilova&#x27;s creative work have been published on many occasions in influential media outlets in Oman.</p>
i18n/scientists-profiles.json:703 Akif Suleymanov — L059, L246/profiles/40/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Akif Suleymanov is a well-known lawyer and scientist in the field of constitutional law and public administration. He has the degrees of Doctor of Philosophy in Law (Ph.D.) and Doctor of Legal Sciences. His research is mainly devoted to theoretical and practical aspects of interaction between the President of Kazakhstan and the Constitutional Council and public control over executive authorities.</p><p class="bio">Professor Suleymanov, who has more than twenty years of academic experience, worked in pedagogical and administrative positions in a number of prestigious higher education institutions of Kazakhstan: Academy of Economics and Law, National Pedagogical University named after Abay, Narkhoz University and Turan University, where he currently works.</p><p class="bio">He is the author or co-author of 2 textbooks and 8 textbooks on public administration, constitutionalism, public control, human and civil rights. More than 100 scientific articles have been published as a result of his research on constitutional law, public control, gender policy and the political system of Kazakhstan. 6 of these articles are published in prestigious international scientific journals indexed in "Scopus." Also, his scientific writings were published in journals approved by the Higher Attestation Commissions of Kazakhstan and CIS countries, as well as in prestigious scientific publications of countries both nearby and farther afield.</p><p class="bio">In addition to his scientific activities, Professor Suleymanov, who actively participates in the field of public administration, is a member of the expert and advisory councils of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, the Constitutional Court and the Fund for the Development of Parliamentarianism.</p><p class="bio">For his scientific achievements and public services, he was awarded the Birlik gold medal, as well as honorary decrees of the Ministry of Justice and Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In addition, he works as a member of the editorial boards of a number of scientific journals in the field of law in Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:720 Arzu Gurbanova — L234/profiles/41/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead"></p><p class="bio">Professor Arzu Gurbanova gave lectures on "English language stylistics," "English grammar," "History of England," &quot;Practical phonetics of the English language&quot; and other subjects. She is the author of the textbooks "English Grammar," "English Phonetics," &quot;English Stylistics&quot; and the monograph "Pedagogical conditions for increasing the independent work of high school students in the English language class."</p><p class="bio">She is the author of more than 250 scientific articles in local and foreign publications, including journals indexed in the &quot;Scopus&quot; database. She has given presentations at international scientific conferences and seminars held in various countries. She was the scientific supervisor of more than 100 master&#x27;s dissertations on English language teaching methodology and served as an examiner in the defense of 2 candidate&#x27;s dissertations.</p><p class="bio">In 2020, she was awarded a letter of thanks by the State Committee for Diaspora Work of the Republic of Azerbaijan for her contributions to diaspora development.</p><p class="bio">She translated the famous Azerbaijani writer Kamal Abdulla&#x27;s &quot;Valley of Sorcerers&quot; from Azerbaijani to Kazakh (2012). Also, she translated the book "Hajimukan - The Mighty One," published on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the famous wrestler Hajimukan Minaytpasov, from Kazakh into Russian and English (2021).</p><p class="bio">Within the scope of her scientific and pedagogical activities, she supervised the dissertation work of more than 150 graduate students.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Excellence in Education&quot; medal, 2013</li><li>20th anniversary medal of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, 2015</li><li>&quot;Birlik&quot; gold medal (&quot;Birlik&quot;), 2018</li><li>&quot;Kind Mother&quot; gold medal, Dede Gorgud Foundation of the Republic of Azerbaijan, 2019</li><li>25th anniversary medal of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, 2020</li><li>&quot;Meirim&quot; badge of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan (&quot;Мейирим&quot;), 2020</li><li>For her activities in the field of international relations and diaspora, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan &quot;For services in diaspora activities&quot; in 2024</li><li>30th anniversary medal of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, 2025</li></ul></div>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:754 Akif Alaferdov — L063/profiles/43/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Akif Alaferdov is a well-known traumatologist, a descendant of Azerbaijanis who were deported to Kyrgyzstan in 1933.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Akif made important contributions to the methodology of surgical treatment of femoral neck fractures. McMurray received a patent for the invention of the &quot;detachable fixator&quot; used in surgery. Akif Alaferdov is the author of a monograph, more than 35 scientific articles, 3 methodological resources and more than 20 effective recommendations on the treatment of femoral neck fractures with surgical intervention.</p><p class="bio">During his professional career, Alaferdov was the head of the complex trauma department at the National Hospital of the Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic and a member of the Special Scientific Council of the Kyrgyz State Medical Institute. He has performed thousands of operations and trained highly qualified specialists. His contributions in this field were recognized by the President of the Kyrgyz Republic with an Honorary Order in 1997, and in 2003 he was awarded the title of "Honored Doctor."</p><p class="bio">In addition to his achievements in the field of medicine, Alaferdov was also engaged in social and cultural activities. From 1997 to 2013, he was the chairman of the &quot;Azeri&quot; Public Union of Azerbaijanis living in Kyrgyzstan. Under his leadership, Sunday schools in the Azerbaijani language were opened, mosques were built, and a folklore ensemble called &quot;Stars&quot; was created. He took part in many events to strengthen the relations between Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan and organized &quot;Bishkek-Baku&quot; telebridges for many years with the participation of deputies, writers, public figures and diaspora representatives from both sides.</p><p class="bio">For his long-term public activity, Akif Alaferdov was awarded the &quot;Dank&quot; state award in 2008, as well as the medal &quot;For service in Diaspora activity&quot; from the State Committee for Work with the Diaspora of the Republic of Azerbaijan. In 2023, he was awarded the Order of &quot;Friend&quot; by the President of Kyrgyzstan for his contributions to strengthening peace, friendship and cooperation between nations. He was awarded the &quot;Chingiz Aytmatov&quot; medal for his achievements in the fields of culture, science, literature and social activities.</p><p class="bio">He was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal in 2026 by order of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mr. Ilham Aliyev for his services in the field of strengthening friendship between peoples and the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</p><div class="card-resources"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="akif-alaferdov-media.html">Additional resources <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></a></div>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:806 Aladdin Allahverdiyev — L269/profiles/46/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">He completed his undergraduate and postgraduate studies at the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of the Moscow State University named after M. V. Lomonosov.</p><p class="bio">He is a well-known Soviet, Russian and Azerbaijani scientist who develops mathematical models and methods for studying wave and oscillation processes in the creation of piezoelectric devices and apparatus. These are used in research on the world ocean and outer space, marine seismic exploration, and the electronics, defense and medical industries.</p><p class="bio">For the first time, he managed to solve the problem of determining the optimal shape of piezoelectric elements, which has not been solved for many years, meets the physical properties required in the dynamic mode, and has a minimum mass or volume. The solution to this problem made it possible to determine the location and individual characteristics of objects moving under water in the world ocean, the information of interest to experts in relevant scientific fields was recorded from space objects - artificial satellites and spaceships, and the creation of receiver-transmitter devices to transmit and receive the Flight Control Center. For the first time, he successfully applied the method of solving two- and three-dimensional dynamic problems, which are important in the creation of piezoelectric devices used in military equipment. The existence of the &quot;edge effect&quot; in disk-shaped piezoceramic membranes was also theoretically discovered by him for the first time. The piezoceramic actuator, developed jointly with the co-authors, was successfully used to solve the problem of creating an artificial heart. He is the author of more than 450 open and closed (confidential) scientific works, inventions, monographs, higher education textbooks, and a number of scientific articles on the problems of organizing higher professional education and educational technologies. Under his scientific guidance, 7 graduate students, including 3 Azerbaijanis, defended their candidate dissertations. In general, based on the obtained scientific results, he delivered more than 60 presentations, including 12 commissioned plenary presentations, at 30 international and general congresses, conferences and symposia.</p><p class="bio">Some of the prizes and awards received by Professor Aladdin Allahverdiyev for his achievements in the fields of science, technology and education:</p><p class="bio">Medal named after the Hero of Socialist Labor of the Russian Cosmonautics Federation, lieutenant general, Lenin Prize laureate, professor, chairman of the State Commission on Space Programs Georgy Alexandrovich Tyulin;</p><p class="bio">Medal named after Khalil Ahmadovich Rakhmatulin, Hero of Socialist Labor of the National Committee for Theoretical and Applied Mechanics of the Russian Academy of Sciences, academician, laureate of four Orders of Lenin, several State Prizes;</p><p class="bio">the title &quot;Honored worker of higher vocational education of the Russian Federation&quot;;</p><p class="bio">Three times—in 1975, 1977 and 1980—badges of &quot;The winner of the race of socialism&quot; established by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, the former Council of Ministers of the USSR, the Central Committee of Trade Unions, the Central Committee of the All-Union Labor Party;</p><p class="bio">&quot;850th anniversary of Moscow&quot; state medal;</p><p class="bio">Jubilee medal &quot;250th anniversary of MSU named after M.V. Lomonosov&quot;;</p><p class="bio">Gold medal of the All-Russian Exhibition Center;</p><p class="bio">diploma of the winner of the review-competition of the Presidium of the Central Office of the All-Union Scientific Medical-Technical Society;</p><p class="bio">Laureate titles and cash prizes for 4 consecutive years (2001–2004) in the "Moscow Grant" competition established by the Moscow Government for science and technology in the field of education;</p><p class="bio">Numerous honorary decrees, diplomas, certificates, and other honors from the Russian Federation, several foreign countries, and many international institutions and organizations.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:993 Azer Abdullayev — L250/profiles/57/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Azer Jafar oglu Abdullayev, a doctor of medical sciences, traumatologist-orthopedic surgeon, and inventor, is a medical scientist with extensive scientific and practical experience in the field of traumatology and orthopedics. He has worked as a teacher, assistant and associate professor at Azerbaijan Medical University for many years, and since 2004 he has been the head of the Orthopedic Department and consultant surgeon at King Fahad and Sabya Hospitals located in Gizan, Saudi Arabia.</p><p class="bio">Abdullayev, who was born in 1955 in Sharur, Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, entered the Faculty of Medicine and Prevention of Azerbaijan Medical University in 1972, and in 1979 he completed the surgery internship. In 1989, he was awarded the degree of doctor of philosophy in medicine, and in 2012, he was awarded the degree of doctor of medical sciences.</p><p class="bio">His research is marked by considerable inventiveness. He is the author of 6 inventions—including an external fixation device, a compression pin and a healing ointment—that are widely used in medical practice, known by such names as "Abdullayev apparatus," &quot;Abdullayev stick&quot; and "Abdullayev ointment." These inventions have been used in the treatment of thousands of patients and have given positive results.</p><p class="bio">Professor Abdullayev&#x27;s research and teaching activities are also extensive: he is the author of more than 70 scientific articles and 2 teaching methodology resources, and the owner of 6 invention patents. His work made significant contributions to the development of practical health care, along with important scientific innovations in the field of traumatology and orthopedics.</p>

These inventions have been used to treat thousands of patients with positive results.</p><p class="bio">Professor Abdullayev&#x27;s research and teaching activities are also extensive: he is the author of more than 70 scientific articles and 2 teaching methodology resources, and the owner of 6 invention patents. i18n/scientists-profiles.json:1080 Elchin Badalov — L087/profiles/62/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Associate Professor Elchin Badalov was admitted to the Faculty of Dentistry of Azerbaijan Medical University in 2002. According to the cooperation agreement signed between Azerbaijan Medical University and Istanbul University in 2003, he successfully passed the selection exam for excellent students and continued his education as an especially talented student at the Faculty of Dentistry of Istanbul University within the framework of the state program.</p><p class="bio">In 2007, he graduated with honors from the Faculty of Dentistry of Istanbul University and began his doctoral studies at the Department of Oral Implantology of the same university. In 2014, he defended his thesis on &quot;Effects of Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor on Bone Tissue Growth in an Experimental Mouse Model&quot; and received a Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) degree in medical sciences.</p><p class="bio">Since 2014, he has been working as a researcher and educator at the Department of Oral, Dental and Maxillofacial Surgery of the Faculty of Dentistry of Istanbul Aydın University. In 2023, he was awarded the scientific degree of associate professor.</p><p class="bio">Under the guidance of Associate Professor E. Badalov, 7 doctoral dissertation topics were developed, and supervision of this work is ongoing. He is the author of more than 30 articles and 3 books published in international indexed scientific journals. At the same time, two surgical methods bearing his surname were applied to medical practice.</p><p class="bio">Within the framework of his scientific activity, he has given presentations at more than 100 international scientific conferences held in different countries, and has organized professional development courses and training sessions related to surgical methods and clinical experience.</p><p class="bio">For more than 10 years, he has been working as a member of the scientific committees (Opinion Leader) of four international dental implant brands from America, Germany, Turkey and Israel, and has been conducting theoretical and practical training programs for doctors.</p><p class="bio">Associate Professor Elchin Badalov is one of a limited number of leading scientists specializing in dental implantology and working in Turkey. He is considered one of the outstanding scientists among Azerbaijani specialists working in this field.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Honorary professor of Bilkend University, leading researcher of Nanotechnology Scientific Research Center</p><p class="bio">Professor Amirulla Mammadov (known as Emirullah M. Mehmetov in scientific publications) is an internationally recognized scientist in the fields of optics, nonlinear optics, laser physics, metamaterials, topological insulators, photonics, nanophotonics and biomedical modeling. He received a doctor of philosophy (Ph.D.) degree in physics and mathematics at the &quot;Ioffe&quot; Institute of Physics and Mathematics of the former USSR Academy of Sciences, and then a doctor of sciences (habilitas doctor) degree, and in 1988 he was awarded the title of professor of "Optics."</p><p class="bio">He continued his research activities in the world&#x27;s leading science and technology centers—Stanford, Caltech, Wisconsin and Rome &quot;La Sapienza&quot; universities, US military laboratories, as well as in Japan and various European countries. At the same time, he is a member of the Board of Trustees of the Turkey-Azerbaijan Friendship, Cooperation and Solidarity Charitable Society and the chairman of the Association of Azerbaijani Scientists (ABID) operating in Turkey. i18n/scientists-profiles.json:1114 Hajali Najafoglu — L091, L252/profiles/64/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Hajali Najafoglu received his higher education in chemistry at Azerbaijan State University, and then received his doctorate in inorganic chemistry at the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences. Since the 1990s, he has worked academically as an associate professor and professor at various universities in Turkey, especially at Qafqaz University.</p><p class="bio">His research output is extensive: in the field of chemistry, more than 200 articles have been published in prestigious journals indexed in the "Web of Science" and "Scopus" scientific databases. In addition, he is the author of 3 books and 26 articles in the humanities, and the editor of 7 books. He also gave presentations at 104 international scientific conferences, and in 1988 he was registered as the author of inventions No. 1471352 and 1471353.</p><p class="bio">Professor Najafoglu has been the scientific supervisor of 11 Ph.D. students and 19 graduate students. His main research areas are the synthesis of metal complexes and the study of their crystallographic, thermal and biological properties. In particular, his fundamental research on nicotinamide and various metal carboxylate complexes made significant contributions to the development of chemistry. He earned a strong reputation in the scientific community with his work in the field of analysis of crystal structures, thermal analysis and synthesis of bioactive substances. His multifaceted scientific and pedagogical activity played an important role in the development of regional and international cooperation in the field of chemistry. Scientific metrics in Google Scholar: h-index: 25, i10-index: 82. WOS h-index: 19.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Ismixhan Bayramoglu specializes in probability theory, statistics and stochastic processes. His research interests include mathematics, probability and statistics, and reliability engineering. In particular, his research in the areas of probability and statistics, reliability theory, ordinal random variables, copula theory, and dependence modeling has made important contributions to the development of new concepts and theoretical approaches in these fields. In 1988, he received a Ph.D. degree from Kyiv State University, and during his scientific career, he worked in a number of prestigious scientific and academic institutions in Azerbaijan and Turkey.</p><p class="bio">Since 2001, he has been working as a professor and dean at Izmir University of Economics. Before that, he worked as a professor at Ankara University and as a research worker at the Azerbaijan National Aerospace Agency. Teaching activities include statistics and mathematics at undergraduate and graduate levels. Professor Bayramov has supervised more than 17 Ph.D. graduates, many of whom are currently pursuing academic careers at universities internationally. He has published more than 120 scientific articles in international journals with a high impact factor, 75 of which have been published in journals indexed in SCI and SCI Expanded. At the same time, he is the author of three international books in the field of probability and statistics. A member of the editorial boards of several international journals, the scientist also serves as the editor-in-chief of the "Statistics" journal.</p><p class="bio">His research is documented on major scholarly platforms such as "Web of Science," &quot;ORCID&quot; and "Google Scholar." He participated as an invited speaker in numerous international conferences, which is an indicator of his international reputation in his field.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Oruj Allahverdiyev graduated from Istanbul University Jarrahpaşa Faculty of Medicine in the field of medical pharmacology. He is the co-author of 4 scientific books, 1 textbook, and more than 100 scientific works in the field of medicine and pharmacy. He participated in many scientific symposia in Turkey and other countries.</p><p class="bio">After high school, Oruj Allahverdiyev was admitted to the Faculty of Pharmacy of Azerbaijan Medical University. Having succeeded in the Turkish government&#x27;s educational exam, he was sent to Turkey to continue his studies at Istanbul University. After graduating from Istanbul University Faculty of Pharmacy in 2006, he began his master&#x27;s studies at the Department of Pharmacology and Clinical Pharmacology, Faculty of Medicine of Istanbul University, and graduated in 2009. During his master's studies, he conducted many scientific studies on brain diseases, and these studies were published in world-renowned international journals. During his studies, several of his research projects received awards from TUBITAK.</p><p class="bio">Later, he began his doctoral studies at the Department of Medical Pharmacology of the Czarrahpaşa Medical Faculty of Istanbul University. In 2014, he completed his doctoral studies as an &quot;Honor Student&quot; and received the scientific degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Medical Sciences. During his doctoral studies, he conducted a number of scientific studies on brain diseases such as substance addiction, epilepsy, depression, Parkinson&#x27;s and multiple sclerosis. These studies have been presented at world-renowned international symposia, congresses and conferences and published in prestigious journals.</p><p class="bio">Oruj Allahverdiyev graduated from the Faculty of Management of Medical Institutions of Istanbul University in 2017 and was awarded the title of associate professor in the field of medical pharmacology by the Higher Education Council of Turkey (YÖK). He trained more than 10 graduate students under his scientific guidance. Currently, he is the co-author of more than 100 scientific works, 1 textbook and 4 scientific books, as well as a number of scientific articles. More than 30 of his scientific works have been published in journals indexed in "Science Citation Index." Currently, Associate Professor Dr. O. Allahverdiyev continues his scientific activities in Turkey.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">After graduating from the journalism faculty of Baku State University, he worked as a journalist and editor in the Azerbaijani press for many years. In 2007, he defended his thesis on &quot;Armenian issue&quot; and received the degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Political Sciences. Since 2010, he has been working as a professor in the department of Armenian language and culture at Erciyes University in Kayseri, Turkey.</p><p class="bio">Prof. Gafar Mehdiyev is also the head of the Armenian Studies Center of Azerbaijan and the League of Independent Investigative Journalists. His works have been published in Azerbaijan, Turkey and a number of foreign countries. The textbook "Armenian Lessons" is used in teaching at Turkish universities. In 2005, he was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal by the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan. He knows Turkish, Armenian, Russian and German languages.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles.json:1284 Saleh Sultansoy — L108/profiles/74/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">He has authored more than 1,500 scientific articles in high-energy physics and accelerator technologies, spoken at more than 100 international scientific conferences, and supervised more than 20 Ph.D. students.</p><p class="bio">Professor Saleh Sultansoy currently works at TOBB University of Economics and Technology located in Ankara. He specializes in high-energy physics, particle accelerators, history of science and science policy. In 1969–1974, he studied at Azerbaijan State University, and in 1985, he received a doctoral degree at the Institute of High Energy Physics in Serpukhov, Russia. During his career, he worked in prestigious institutions such as the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences, Ankara University, DESY (Germany), Gazi University and TOBB ETÜ.</p><p class="bio">His works have been cited more than 81,000 times in Web of Science, more than 275,000 times in Google Scholar, and more than 235,000 times by HEP Inspire. His h-indices are 127, 208 and 215, respectively.</p><p class="bio">His main research areas are high-energy physics, accelerator technologies and scientific strategies. In 2013, he was awarded the &quot;Engin Arık&quot; science prize of the Turkish Physics Society, and in 2016, he was awarded the &quot;Golden Apple&quot; science prize of the Turkish world.</p><p class="bio">Saleh Sultansoy was a member of scientific councils at CERN and other international research centers, and actively participated in the development of scientific policy in Turkey and the Turkic world. He is one of the founders and leaders of the Turkish Accelerator Complex (TAC) project, a long-term national scientific research initiative, the author of the ATAM (Ankara Fundamental Research Center) initiative, and a participant in ATLAS, CLIC, LHeC, FCC and other CERN projects. He was also the scientific leader of a number of advanced projects on accelerator technologies conducted within the framework of DPT-TAEK and TUBITAK.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">In 2008, Prof. Dr. Teymur Rzayev, Honored Artist of the Republic of Azerbaijan, was the creator and head of the &quot;Desen Anfisi&quot; (black pencil drawing workshop) project at the Faculty of Fine Arts of Yeditepe University of the Republic of Turkey. The workshop, as the first and only example in this field in Turkey, has become a prestigious art space where students study with great interest and pleasure.</p><p class="bio">During his academic career, Prof. Dr. Rzayev trained numerous students: dozens of undergraduate students, 18 master&#x27;s and 7 doctoral students graduated. So far, he has participated in 43 local and 18 international exhibitions, 26 local and 12 international symposia, and his works of art are displayed in the permanent collections of 3 local and 8 international museums.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Official scientific and honorary titles, awards, positions received:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>He has been a member of the Union of Artists of Azerbaijan since 1991.</li><li>In 2014, the Inter-University Council of the Republic of Turkey gave him the academic title and position of docent.</li><li>In 2009, he was awarded the scientific degree of Doctor of Philosophy in art studies by the Higher Attestation Commission under the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li><li>In 2011, he was awarded the honorary title of Honored Artist of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li><li>In 2013, he was awarded the &quot;Shuvalov&quot; medal of the Russian Academy of Arts.</li><li>In 2015, he was awarded the gold medal of the Russian Academy of Arts "For service to the Academy."</li><li>In 2016, he was awarded the Order of the Republic of Azerbaijan "For Service to the Motherland, III degree."</li><li>In 2017, he was elected Honorary Academician of the Russian Academy of Arts.</li><li>In 2020, he was given the academic title and authority of &quot;professor&quot; by the Board of Directors of Yeditepe University of the Republic of Turkey.</li><li>In 2022, he was awarded a special medal for his services to the Azerbaijani Diaspora.</li><li>In 2022, he was elected a member of the Coordinating Council of Azerbaijanis Living Abroad under the chairmanship of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mr. Ilham Aliyev.</li><li>In 2024, he was elected a member of the Board of the World Union of Azerbaijani Scientists.</li></ul></div><div class="card-resources"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="teymur-rzayev-media.html">Additional resources <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></a></div>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Aytekin Huseynli is an international specialist in social policy, social work, child and family welfare. Dr. Huseynli is an assistant professor at the University of Washington. Her applied research focuses on the formulation of social policies, especially the improvement of family and child welfare. Aytekin Huseynli also explores strategies and ways to channel natural resource revenues into social development in countries rich in oil, gas and minerals. Aytekin Huseynli&#x27;s doctoral dissertation led to the creation of the National Children&#x27;s Fund state program, which covers 7 million children in Kazakhstan and is financed by a portion of the oil and gas wealth.</p><p class="bio">She is the author of 3 chapters in 3 books in the field of social policy, social work and social development, 15 scientific articles in 15 international scientific journals, and more than 20 publications, and she is a member of the editorial boards of 2 scientific journals in the field of social development, social policy and social work. Currently, she is the head of several research projects.</p><p class="bio">A pioneer in her field, Aytekin Huseynli is one of the first professional social workers who received an education in the field of social work in the post-Soviet region and is one of the founders of the social work profession and education in Azerbaijan. i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-01.json:1 Messoud Efendiyev — L264, L265/profiles/7/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Head of the &quot;Dynamic Systems&quot; Department at the &quot;Helmholtz&quot; Scientific Research Center, Munich, Germany</p><p class="bio">Rector&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor at Marmara University, Istanbul, Turkey</p><p class="bio">Professor Masud Efendiyev is the first Azerbaijani scientist living abroad, known both for the prestigious international awards he won and the international conferences organized in his honor. Although he has been living and working in Germany for more than 35 years, he remains a citizen of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Contributions to nonlinear analysis and mathematical physics</p><p class="bio">He created a new theory of topological invariants for the global solution of nonlinear equations.</p><p class="bio">These invariants play an important role in the analysis of qualitative changes (local and global bifurcation) of nonlinear systems.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Mathematical modeling</p><p class="bio">He conducted fundamental research on mathematical modeling of problems encountered in the fields of biology, medicine, ecology, mechanics and physics.</p><p class="bio">He created new classes of attractors of dynamic systems according to evolution equations and made an important contribution to their systematic study.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international scientific journals</p><p class="bio">He is a member of the editorial boards of more than ten leading international journals.</p><p class="bio">He is the editor-in-chief of "International Journal of Biomathematics and Biostatistics."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific publications</p><p class="bio">He is the author of 8 books published in Japan, Germany, the USA, Canada and Switzerland.</p><p class="bio">He has written more than 200 scientific articles and collaborated with co-authors from 15 countries.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international universities</p><p class="bio">In 2018, he lectured for 6 months at the University of Toronto and the Fields Institute as a &quot;Dean&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor&quot; and played an important role in the implementation of the thematic program "Emerging Challenges in Mathematical Biology."</p><p class="bio">In 2019, he was invited to the University of Waterloo as a "James D. Murray Distinguished Visiting Professor."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honors</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>In 1991, he was the first Azerbaijani scientist to win the &quot;Alexander von Humboldt&quot; award established by the German government.</li><li>In 2005, he was awarded the prestigious &quot;Japan Society for the Promotion of Science - JSPS&quot; award.</li><li>In 2007, he won the prestigious &quot;Otto Monsted&quot; award of the Danish government. He is the first Azerbaijani scientist to win these awards.</li><li>In 2022, he was awarded the honorary title of Honored Scientist by the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliyev.</li><li>In 2023, he was awarded the Life Achievement Award of the Fields Institute.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">International conferences and recognition</p><p class="bio">The 60th anniversary of teacher Masud was celebrated in Germany (Munich), and the 70th anniversary was celebrated in Baku (at the state level) with international scientific conferences.</p><p class="bio">75 leading scientists from 25 countries participated in the conference held in Munich.</p><p class="bio">55 famous scientists from 23 countries participated in the conference held in Baku.</p>
