He has more than 80 patents and more than 150 scientific articles.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Main research areas</p><p class="bio">Green hydrogen and renewable energy: Development of electrolysis and fuel cell technologies.</p><p class="bio">Surface technologies and tribology: Coating technologies, thin-film sensors and nanotechnologies.</p><p class="bio">Automotive and e-mobility: Fuel efficiency and sustainable mobility solutions.</p><p class="bio">Strategic R&amp;D management: Strategic roadmaps, partnerships with global universities and research institutes.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Professional experience</p><p class="bio">Siemens Energy AG (2020–present): Green hydrogen and new energy technologies, Senior Management</p><p class="bio">Schaeffler AG (2005–2020): Global research activities in nanotechnology, tribology and fuel cell technologies, leading teams of 100+ scientists and engineers, Senior Vice President</p><p class="bio">SIA Schaeffler Baltic, CEO (2016–2018): Led the acquisition and integration of Naco Technologies by Schaeffler AG.</p><p class="bio">Other positions: H-O-T GmbH, Erlangen-Nuremberg University, Daimler AG Azerbaijan partner, Azerbaijan Technical University.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and recognition</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>Global Japanese car manufacturer &quot;Supplier&quot; award (2017).</li><li>Materialica Design + Technology award (2016, 2014).</li><li>One of Germany's top 5 innovators (2005–2020).</li><li>Honorary diploma of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, 2022</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">Education and professional training</p><p class="bio">Doctorate (Dr.-Ing.), Erlangen-Nürnberg University (2001).</p><p class="bio">DAAD Scholar, University of Erlangen-Nuremberg (1997–1998).</p><p class="bio">Mechanical Engineering (Dipl.-Ing.), Azerbaijan Technical University (1991).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Membership and international relations</p><p class="bio">&quot;Nano in Germany e.V.&quot; founding member.</p><p class="bio">&quot;BalticNet-Plasmatech e.V.&quot; Chairman of the Board.</p><p class="bio">&quot;Baku-Nuremberg e.V.&quot; Chairman of the Board.</p><p class="bio">Member of the Association of German Engineers (VDI).</p><p class="bio">Chairman of the Board of the Union of Engineers of European Azerbaijanis</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Azerbaijan ETN Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnologies in Baku, group leader and laboratory manager</p><p class="bio-section-title">Research areas:</p><p class="bio">Prof. Dr. Garib Murshudov is one of the world&#x27;s leading scientists in the field of molecular biology, crystallography and structural biology. His main research directions are as follows:</p><p class="bio">Macromolecular crystallography and structural biology (analysis of three-dimensional structures of proteins and nucleic acids).</p><p class="bio">Cryo-electron microscopy (Cryo-EM) and bioinformatics (molecular modeling, structural analysis and data processing).</p><p class="bio">Statistical and mathematical modeling (application of maximum likelihood and Bayesian statistical methods in biological systems).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Academic and professional experience:</p><p class="bio">He works as a group leader at the MRC Molecular Biology Laboratory (Cambridge, Great Britain) and as a laboratory manager at the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnology of the Ministry of Science and Education of Azerbaijan (Baku).</p><p class="bio">He worked in prestigious research institutes and universities in Great Britain, Russia and Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">He is the main author of the software that constructs atomic models of macromolecules using experiments, renders them transparent and checks them statistically (REFMAC, BALBES, Servalcat, AceDRG, etc.).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and recognition:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>He was awarded the honorary title of &quot;Honored Scientist&quot; of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li><li>Won the Wellcome Trust Senior Fellowship—the UK's most prestigious fellowship in biology</li><li>Member of the European Molecular Biology Organization (EMBO).</li><li>Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society of Great Britain.</li><li>Member of the CCP4 executive committee – this committee brings together leading international researchers in the field of computational structural biology.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">Publications and scientific contributions:</p><p class="bio">He is the author of more than 120 high-impact scientific articles, including in prestigious journals such as Nature, Science, PNAS and Acta Crystallographica.</p><p class="bio">He was a leading researcher in the development of innovative software (REFMAC5, SERVALCAT, EMDA, BALBES, AceDRG) for the analysis and modeling of molecular structures.</p><p class="bio">He regularly participates in international symposia and conferences and organizes scientific seminars in different countries (Great Britain, Japan, China, USA, Brazil, India, etc.).</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-02.json:1 Vehid Geruslu — L030, L231/profiles/0/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Dr. Vahid Garousi works in two professional roles: as an IT specialist and an IT professor. Since 1998 he has provided consulting and training to international IT companies in software engineering, testing and QA, and he is also a professor of software engineering at Queen&#x27;s University in Belfast, United Kingdom. At the same time, he serves as a part-time software test strategist and team leader at ProSys LLC in Azerbaijan and Testinium A.Ş. in Turkey. His name is written in English as Vahid Garousi.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi earned his Ph.D. in software engineering from Carleton University in Canada in 2006 and his master&#x27;s degree from the University of Waterloo in Canada in 2003. Over more than 25 years of IT experience, he served as the lead test and QA consultant for the United Kingdom&#x27;s COVID mobile application in 2020–2021, as a test consultant for one of the UK&#x27;s major banks in 2022, and as the lead test and QA consultant at HAVELSAN in Turkey from 2012 to 2019.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi is a professor of software engineering at Queen&#x27;s University in Belfast, United Kingdom. Previously he held associate professor positions in the Netherlands (2017–2019), Turkey (2015–2017) and Canada (2001–2014). He received his Ph.D. in software engineering from Carleton University in Canada in 2006. His research areas are software engineering, software testing, empirical studies, action research and industry–academia collaboration. In parallel with his academic career, he is a practicing consultant and trainer in software engineering, delivering consulting and corporate training across various areas including software engineering, testing and quality assurance, model-driven development and software maintenance.</p><p class="bio">In a bibliometric study published in the Journal of Systems and Software in 2018, Dr. Garousi was ranked the 8th most active mid-career software engineering researcher in the world, out of more than 4,000 active researchers. Dr. Garousi has published more than 150 papers to date. He was selected as a Distinguished Speaker by the IEEE Computer Society in 2012–2015. He is also a member of the IEEE and the IEEE Computer Society and a licensed professional engineer (PEng) in Alberta, Canada.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi has been the principal investigator of several research projects and has launched many significant R&amp;D software engineering projects together with software companies in several countries, including Canada and Turkey. He has served as an organizer and program committee member at many international conferences, such as ICST, ICSP, CSEE&amp;T, MoDELS and the Turkish National Software Engineering Conference. Among the awards he has received is the Alberta Ingenuity New Faculty Award, which he won in 2007.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific achievements and recognition:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>According to the bibliometric study published in &quot;Journal of Systems and Software&quot; in 2018, Dr. Garuslu is rated as the 8th most active mid-career software engineering researcher worldwide (out of over 4,000 active researchers).</li><li>He is the author of more than 150 scientific articles and has made extensive academic contributions in his field.</li><li>In 2012–2015, he was selected as a Distinguished Speaker by the IEEE Computer Society.</li><li>He is a member of the IEEE Computer Society and a licensed professional engineer (PEng) in Alberta, Canada.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">More information:</p><ul class="bullets profile-links"><li><a href="http://www.vgarousi.com" target="_blank" Before

<p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli is a poet, translator, scholar and public figure. In addition to his extensive research in Azerbaijani literature, linguistics and journalism, he is also known internationally for diaspora activity and academic cooperation. With his scientific work "Comparison of Verb Structures in Estonian and Turkish Languages," he is the first Azerbaijani scholar to investigate kinship relations between Finno-Ugric and Turkic-Tatar languages in world linguistics.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Main research areas</p><p class="bio-section-title">Turkology and linguistics:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Comparison of Verb Structures in Estonian and Turkish Languages&quot;</li><li>&quot;Linguistic relations and structural differences between Turkish and Estonian&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Political and cultural relations:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Political and cultural relations between Estonia and the Turkic World&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Journalism and visual media:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;The importance of photography in the print media&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honorary titles:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Progress&quot; medal (2022) – awarded by the President of Azerbaijan for his contribution to the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</li><li>&quot;Golden Star Medal&quot; (2024) – awarded by the International Academy of Sciences for Turkic World Studies of the Republic of Turkey.</li><li>Medal &quot;For service in diaspora activity&quot; (2024) – presented by the State Committee on Work with Diaspora of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Publications and literary activity:</p><p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli is the author of both scholarly and journalistic articles and works of poetry and prose. His works have been translated into Estonian, Georgian, Russian, Latvian, German, English and Turkic languages.</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>Author of more than 40 sociopolitical, historical and scientific-cultural articles;</li><li>author of 6 books and 1 monograph;</li><li>author of 4 scientific articles published in 2 scientific journals;</li><li>speaker and participant at more than 20 international symposia and conferences.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Professional and academic activity:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>Finno-Ugric and Turkic Peoples Research Center – chairman</li><li>University of Tartu (Estonia) – director of the Turkish Language Center</li><li>World Congress of Azerbaijanis – member of the Board, deputy chairman</li><li>Estonian-Azerbaijani Society – chairman</li><li>World Association of Azerbaijani Scientists – member of the Organizing Committee</li><li>Azerbaijan Writers&#x27; Union – member</li><li>Estonian Society of Academic Orientalists – member</li><li>Turkish Literature Foundation – honorary member</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Diplomatic and translation activity:</p><p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli has participated as a translator in high-level official meetings in Estonia and Turkey. He served as a special interpreter during official visits by the presidents, parliament speakers and ministers of Azerbaijan, Turkey and Estonia.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Honorary professor of Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University</p><p class="bio">Professor Lev Eppelbaum (Tel Aviv University, Department of Geophysics) is the author of approximately 460 scientific publications. These include 12 books, 18 book chapters, 194 peer-reviewed journal articles, 81 conference materials and 171 abstracts published by international scientific publishers (Kluwer Academic Publisher, Springer, Elsevier, Chapman and Hall, Institute of Physics (Great Britain)). Prof. Eppelbaum&#x27;s main research areas are geodynamics and tectonic reconstructions, applied and environmental geophysics, archaeological geophysics, and integrated analysis of geophysical, geological and related data.</p><p class="bio">He was elected head of scientific departments 26 times at international conferences. Professor Lev Eppelbaum is the editor-in-chief of the journal "Geology, Geophysics, and Earth Sciences" and a member of the editorial boards of such prestigious journals as "Positioning," "Open Petroleum Engineering Journal," "Archaeological Discovery," "Stratigraphy, Petroleum, Sedimentology, Geochemistry," "ANAS Transactions, Earth Sciences," "International Journal of Earthquake Engineering," "Discover Geoscience," "Academy Green Energy," "Contributions to Geosciences," "Geosciences," "Russian Journal of Physical Chemistry," and "World Journal of Physics." At the same time, he served as a guest editor for the journals "Advances in Geosciences," "Journal of Geophysics and Engineering," "Continent and Life Evolution," "Frontiers in Earth Sciences," "Geosciences (Switzerland)," &quot;Land&quot; and "Applied Sciences (Switzerland)."</p><p class="bio">Professor Lev Eppelbaum is a member of two international geophysical commissions: the "Rotation of the Earth" commission and "WebmedCentral Ecology Advisory Board."</p><p class="bio">In 2020, he was awarded the title of honorary professor of the Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University, and in 2023, he was elected a foreign member of the Georgian Academy of Sciences.</p><p class="bio">Professor Eppelbaum has received several awards; among them is the Christian Huygens medal of the European Geosciences Union (2019).</p><p class="bio">According to Google Scholar, his scholarly publications have been cited nearly 8,000 times.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-02.json:1 Akif Suleymanov — L059, L246/profiles/19/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Akif Suleymanov is a well-known lawyer and scientist in the field of constitutional law and public administration. He has the degrees of Doctor of Philosophy in Law (Ph.D.) and Doctor of Legal Sciences. His research is mainly devoted to theoretical and practical aspects of interaction between the President of Kazakhstan and the Constitutional Council and public control over executive authorities.</p><p class="bio">Professor Suleymanov, who has more than twenty years of academic experience, worked in pedagogical and administrative positions in a number of prestigious higher education institutions of Kazakhstan: Academy of Economics and Law, National Pedagogical University named after Abay, Narkhoz University and Turan University, where he currently works.</p><p class="bio">He is the author or co-author of 2 textbooks and 8 textbooks on public administration, constitutionalism, public control, human and civil rights. More than 100 scientific articles have been published as a result of his research on constitutional law, public control, gender policy and the political system of Kazakhstan. 6 of these articles are published in prestigious international scientific journals indexed in "Scopus." Also, his scientific writings were published in journals approved by the Higher Attestation Commissions of Kazakhstan and CIS countries, as well as in prestigious scientific publications of countries both nearby and farther afield.</p><p class="bio">In addition to his scientific activities, Professor Suleymanov, who actively participates in the field of public administration, is a member of the expert and advisory councils of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, the Constitutional Court and the Fund for the Development of Parliamentarianism.</p><p class="bio">For his scientific achievements and public services, he was awarded the Birlik gold medal, as well as honorary decrees of the Ministry of Justice and Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In addition, he works as a member of the editorial boards of a number of scientific journals in the field of law in Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan.</p>

i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-02.json:1 Arzu Gurbanova — L234/profiles/20/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead"></p><p class="bio">Professor Arzu Gurbanova gave lectures on "English language stylistics," "English grammar," "History of England," &quot;Practical phonetics of the English language&quot; and other subjects. She is the author of the textbooks "English Grammar," "English Phonetics," &quot;English Stylistics&quot; and the monograph "Pedagogical conditions for increasing the independent work of high school students in the English language class."</p><p class="bio">She is the author of more than 250 scientific articles in local and foreign publications, including journals indexed in the &quot;Scopus&quot; database. She has given presentations at international scientific conferences and seminars held in various countries. She was the scientific supervisor of more than 100 master&#x27;s dissertations on English language teaching methodology and served as an examiner in the defense of 2 candidate&#x27;s dissertations.</p><p class="bio">In 2020, she was awarded a letter of thanks by the State Committee for Diaspora Work of the Republic of Azerbaijan for her contributions to diaspora development.</p><p class="bio">She translated the famous Azerbaijani writer Kamal Abdulla&#x27;s &quot;Valley of Sorcerers&quot; from Azerbaijani to Kazakh (2012). Also, she translated the book "Hajimukan - The Mighty One," published on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the famous wrestler Hajimukan Minaytpasov, from Kazakh into Russian and English (2021).</p><p class="bio">Within the scope of her scientific and pedagogical activities, she supervised the dissertation work of more than 150 graduate students.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Excellence in Education&quot; medal, 2013</li><li>20th anniversary medal of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, 2015</li><li>&quot;Birlik&quot; gold medal (&quot;Birlik&quot;), 2018</li><li>&quot;Kind Mother&quot; gold medal, Dede Gorgud Foundation of the Republic of Azerbaijan, 2019</li><li>25th anniversary medal of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, 2020</li><li>&quot;Meirim&quot; badge of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan (&quot;Мейирим&quot;), 2020</li><li>For her activities in the field of international relations and diaspora, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan &quot;For services in diaspora activities&quot; in 2024</li><li>30th anniversary medal of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, 2025</li></ul></div>

i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-03.json:1 Akif Alaferdov — L063/profiles/1/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Akif Alaferdov is a well-known traumatologist, a descendant of Azerbaijanis who were deported to Kyrgyzstan in 1933.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Akif made important contributions to the methodology of surgical treatment of femoral neck fractures. McMurray received a patent for the invention of the &quot;detachable fixator&quot; used in surgery. Akif Alaferdov is the author of a monograph, more than 35 scientific articles, 3 methodological resources and more than 20 effective recommendations on the treatment of femoral neck fractures with surgical intervention.</p><p class="bio">During his professional career, Alaferdov was the head of the complex trauma department at the National Hospital of the Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic and a member of the Special Scientific Council of the Kyrgyz State Medical Institute. He has performed thousands of operations and trained highly qualified specialists. His contributions in this field were recognized by the President of the Kyrgyz Republic with an Honorary Order in 1997, and in 2003 he was awarded the title of "Honored Doctor."</p><p class="bio">In addition to his achievements in the field of medicine, Alaferdov was also engaged in social and cultural activities. From 1997 to 2013, he was the chairman of the &quot;Azeri&quot; Public Union of Azerbaijanis living in Kyrgyzstan. Under his leadership, Sunday schools in the Azerbaijani language were opened, mosques were built, and a folklore ensemble called &quot;Stars&quot; was created. He took part in many events to strengthen the relations between Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan and organized &quot;Bishkek-Baku&quot; telebridges for many years with the participation of deputies, writers, public figures and diaspora representatives from both sides.</p><p class="bio">For his long-term public activity, Akif Alaferdov was awarded the &quot;Dank&quot; state award in 2008, as well as the medal &quot;For service in Diaspora activity&quot; from the State Committee for Work with the Diaspora of the Republic of Azerbaijan. In 2023, he was awarded the Order of &quot;Friend&quot; by the President of Kyrgyzstan for his contributions to strengthening peace, friendship and cooperation between nations. He was awarded the &quot;Chingiz Aytmatov&quot; medal for his achievements in the fields of culture, science, literature and social activities.</p><p class="bio">He was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal in 2026 by order of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mr. Ilham Aliyev for his services in the field of strengthening friendship between peoples and the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</p><div class="card-resources"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="akif-alaferdov-media.html">Additional resources <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></a></div>

i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-03.json:1 Aladdin Allahverdiyev — L269/profiles/4/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">He completed his undergraduate and postgraduate studies at the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of the Moscow State University named after M. V. Lomonosov.</p><p class="bio">He is a well-known Soviet, Russian and Azerbaijani scientist who develops mathematical models and methods for studying wave and oscillation processes in the creation of piezoelectric devices and apparatus. These are used in research on the world ocean and outer space, marine seismic exploration, and the electronics, defense and medical industries.</p><p class="bio">For the first time, he managed to solve the problem of determining the optimal shape of piezoelectric elements, which has not been solved for many years, meets the physical properties required in the dynamic mode, and has a minimum mass or volume. The solution to this problem made it possible to determine the location and individual characteristics of objects moving under water in the world ocean, the information of interest to experts in relevant scientific fields was recorded from space objects - artificial satellites and spaceships, and the creation of receiver-transmitter devices to transmit and receive the Flight Control Center. For the first time, he successfully applied the method of solving two- and three-dimensional dynamic problems, which are important in the creation of piezoelectric devices used in military equipment. The existence of the &quot;edge effect&quot; in disk-shaped piezoceramic membranes was also theoretically discovered by him for the first time. The piezoceramic actuator, developed jointly with the co-authors, was successfully used to solve the problem of creating an artificial heart. He is the author of more than 450 open and closed (confidential) scientific works, inventions, monographs, higher education textbooks, and a number of scientific articles on the problems of organizing higher professional education and educational technologies. Under his scientific guidance, 7 graduate students, including 3 Azerbaijanis, defended their candidate dissertations. <p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Ismixhan Bayramoglu specializes in probability theory, statistics and stochastic processes. In 1988, he received a Ph.D. degree from Kyiv State University, and during his scientific career, he worked in a number of prestigious scientific and academic institutions in Azerbaijan and Turkey.</p><p class="bio">Since 2001, he has been working as a professor and dean at Izmir University of Economics. Teaching activities include statistics and mathematics at undergraduate and graduate levels. Professor Bayramov has supervised more than 17 Ph.D. graduates, many of whom are currently pursuing academic careers at universities internationally. He has published more than 120 scientific articles in international journals with a high impact factor, 75 of which have been published in journals indexed in SCI and SCI Expanded. At the same time, he is the author of three international books in the field of probability and statistics. A member of the editorial boards of several international journals, the scientist also serves as the editor-in-chief of the "Statistics" journal.</p><p class="bio">His research is documented on major scholarly platforms such as "Web of Science," &quot;ORCID&quot; and "Google Scholar." He participated as an invited speaker in numerous international conferences, which is an indicator of his international reputation in his field.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Oruj Allahverdiyev graduated from Istanbul University Jarrahpaşa Faculty of Medicine in the field of medical pharmacology. He is the co-author of 4 scientific books, 1 textbook, and more than 100 scientific works in the field of medicine and pharmacy. He participated in many scientific symposia in Turkey and other countries.</p><p class="bio">After high school, Oruj Allahverdiyev was admitted to the Faculty of Pharmacy of Azerbaijan Medical University. Having succeeded in the Turkish government&#x27;s educational exam, he was sent to Turkey to continue his studies at Istanbul University. After graduating from Istanbul University Faculty of Pharmacy in 2006, he began his master&#x27;s studies at the Department of Pharmacology and Clinical Pharmacology, Faculty of Medicine of Istanbul University, and graduated in 2009. During his master's studies, he conducted many scientific studies on brain diseases, and these studies were published in world-renowned international journals. During his studies, several of his research projects received awards from TUBITAK.</p><p class="bio">Later, he began his doctoral studies at the Department of Medical Pharmacology of the Czarrahpaşa Medical Faculty of Istanbul University. In 2014, he completed his doctoral studies as an &quot;Honor Student&quot; and received the scientific degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Medical Sciences. During his doctoral studies, he conducted a number of scientific studies on brain diseases such as substance addiction, epilepsy, depression, Parkinson&#x27;s and multiple sclerosis. These studies have been presented at world-renowned international symposia, congresses and conferences and published in prestigious journals.</p><p class="bio">Oruj Allahverdiyev graduated from the Faculty of Management of Medical Institutions of Istanbul University in 2017 and was awarded the title of associate professor in the field of medical pharmacology by the Higher Education Council of Turkey (YÖK). He trained more than 10 graduate students under his scientific guidance. Currently, he is the co-author of more than 100 scientific works, 1 textbook and 4 scientific books, as well as a number of scientific articles. More than 30 of his scientific works have been published in journals indexed in "Science Citation Index." Currently, Associate Professor Dr. O. Allahverdiyev continues his scientific activities in Turkey.</p>

Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles.json:36 Aytekin Huseynli — L272, L003, L235/profiles/1/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Aytekin Huseynli is an international specialist in social policy, social work, child and family welfare. Dr. Huseynli is an assistant professor at the University of Washington. Her applied research focuses on the formulation of social policies, especially the improvement of family and child welfare. Aytekin Huseynli also explores strategies and ways to channel natural resource revenues into social development in countries rich in oil, gas and minerals. Aytekin Huseynli&#x27;s doctoral dissertation led to the creation of the National Children&#x27;s Fund state program, which covers 7 million children in Kazakhstan and is financed by a portion of the oil and gas wealth.</p><p class="bio">She is the author of 3 chapters in 3 books in the field of social policy, social work and social development, 15 scientific articles in 15 international scientific journals, and more than 20 publications, and she is a member of the editorial boards of 2 scientific journals in the field of social development, social policy and social work. She gave presentations at more than 20 international scientific conferences and received 2 international awards for her scientific work. She was the scientific supervisor of more than 10 students. Aytekin Huseynli teaches social research, statistics, program evaluation and social policy. Currently, she is the head of several research projects.</p><p class="bio">A pioneer in her field, Aytekin Huseynli is one of the first professional social workers who received an education in the field of social work in the post-Soviet region and is one of the founders of the social work profession and education in Azerbaijan. She is the founder of the "Azerbaijan Social Work" Public Union, which represents Azerbaijan in the field of international and regional social development.</p><p class="bio">She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Global Program at the Brown School of the University of Washington, the deputy director of international programs at the Center for Social Development, and an associate professor at the Center for Child Abuse Research, Training and Education. At the global level, Aytekin Huseynli is a research and statistics specialist for Eurasia at UNICEF and a member of the Research Committee of the International Association of Schools of Social Work.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Head of the &quot;Dynamic Systems&quot; Department at the &quot;Helmholtz&quot; Scientific Research Center, Munich, Germany</p><p class="bio">Rector&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor at Marmara University, Istanbul, Turkey</p><p class="bio">Professor Masud Efendiyev is the first Azerbaijani scientist living abroad, known both for the prestigious international awards he won and the international conferences organized in his honor. Although he has been living and working in Germany for more than 35 years, he remains a citizen of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Contributions to nonlinear analysis and mathematical physics</p><p class="bio">He created a new theory of topological invariants for the global solution of nonlinear equations.</p><p class="bio">These invariants play an important role in the analysis of qualitative changes (local and global bifurcation) of nonlinear systems.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Mathematical modeling</p><p class="bio">He conducted fundamental research on mathematical modeling of problems encountered in the fields of biology, medicine, ecology, mechanics and physics.</p><p class="bio">He created new classes of attractors of dynamic systems according to evolution equations and made an important contribution to their systematic study.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international scientific journals</p><p class="bio">He is a member of the editorial boards of more than ten leading international journals.</p><p class="bio">He is the editor-in-chief of "International Journal of Biomathematics and Biostatistics."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific publications</p><p class="bio">He is the author of 8 books published in Japan, Germany, the USA, Canada and Switzerland.</p><p class="bio">He has written more than 200 scientific articles and collaborated with co-authors from 15 countries.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international universities</p><p class="bio">In 2018, he lectured for 6 months at the University of Toronto and the Fields Institute as a &quot;Dean&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor&quot; and played an important role in the implementation of the thematic program "Emerging Challenges in Mathematical Biology."</p><p class="bio">In 2019, he was invited to the University of Waterloo as a "James D. Murray Distinguished Visiting Professor."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honors</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>In 1991, he was the first Azerbaijani scientist to win the &quot;Alexander von Humboldt&quot; award established by the German government.</li><li>In 2005, he was awarded the prestigious &quot;Japan Society for the Promotion of Science - JSPS&quot; award.</li><li>In 2007, he won the prestigious &quot;Otto Monsted&quot; award of the Danish government. He is the first Azerbaijani scientist to win these awards.</li><li>In 2022, he was awarded the honorary title of Honored Scientist by the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliyev.</li><li>In 2023, he was awarded the Life Achievement Award of the Fields Institute.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">International conferences and recognition</p><p class="bio">The 60th anniversary of teacher Masud was celebrated in Germany (Munich), and the 70th anniversary was celebrated in Baku (at the state level) with international scientific conferences.</p><p class="bio">75 leading scientists from 25 countries participated in the conference held in Munich.</p><p class="bio">55 famous scientists from 23 countries participated in the conference held in Baku.</p>

He is the first Azerbaijani scientist to win these awards.</li><li>In 2022, he was awarded the honorary title of Honored Scientist by the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliyev.</li><li>In 2023, he was awarded the Life Achievement Award of the Fields Institute.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">International conferences and recognition</p><p class="bio">The 60th anniversary of teacher Masud was celebrated in Germany (Munich), and the 70th anniversary was celebrated in Baku (at the state level) with international scientific conferences.</p><p class="bio">75 leading scientists from 25 countries participated in the conference held in Munich.</p><p class="bio">55 famous scientists from 23 countries participated in the conference held in Baku.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Dr. Vahid Garousi works in two professional roles: as an IT specialist and an IT professor. Since 1998 he has provided consulting and training to international IT companies in software engineering, testing and QA, and he is also a professor of software engineering at Queen&#x27;s University in Belfast, United Kingdom. At the same time, he serves as a part-time software test strategist and team leader at ProSys LLC in Azerbaijan and Testinium A.Ş. in Turkey. His name is written in English as Vahid Garousi.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi earned his Ph.D. in software engineering from Carleton University in Canada in 2006 and his master&#x27;s degree from the University of Waterloo in Canada in 2003. Over more than 25 years of IT experience, he served as the lead test and QA consultant for the United Kingdom&#x27;s COVID mobile application in 2020–2021, as a test consultant for one of the UK&#x27;s major banks in 2022, and as the lead test and QA consultant at HAVELSAN in Turkey from 2012 to 2019.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Garousi is a professor of software engineering at Queen&#x27;s University in Belfast, United Kingdom. Previously he held associate professor positions in the Netherlands (2017–2019), Turkey (2015–2017) and Canada (2001–2014). He received his Ph.D. in software engineering from Carleton University in Canada in 2006. His research areas are software engineering, software testing, empirical studies, action research and industry–academia collaboration. In parallel with his academic career, he is a practicing consultant and trainer in software engineering, delivering consulting and corporate training across various areas including software engineering, testing and quality assurance, model-driven development and software maintenance.</p><p class="bio">In a bibliometric study published in the Journal of Systems and Software in 2018, Dr. Garousi was ranked the 8th most active mid-career software engineering researcher in the world, out of more than 4,000 active researchers. Dr. Garousi has published more than 150 papers to date. He was selected as a Distinguished Speaker by the IEEE Computer Society in 2012–2015. <p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli is a poet, translator, scholar and public figure. In addition to his extensive research in Azerbaijani literature, linguistics and journalism, he is also known internationally for diaspora activity and academic cooperation. With his scientific work "Comparison of Verb Structures in Estonian and Turkish Languages," he is the first Azerbaijani scholar to investigate kinship relations between Finno-Ugric and Turkic-Tatar languages in world linguistics.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Main research areas</p><p class="bio-section-title">Turkology and linguistics:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Comparison of Verb Structures in Estonian and Turkish Languages&quot;</li><li>&quot;Linguistic relations and structural differences between Turkish and Estonian&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Political and cultural relations:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Political and cultural relations between Estonia and the Turkic World&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Journalism and visual media:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;The importance of photography in the print media&quot;</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honorary titles:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>&quot;Progress&quot; medal (2022) – awarded by the President of Azerbaijan for his contribution to the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</li><li>&quot;Golden Star Medal&quot; (2024) – awarded by the International Academy of Sciences for Turkic World Studies of the Republic of Turkey.</li><li>Medal &quot;For service in diaspora activity&quot; (2024) – presented by the State Committee on Work with Diaspora of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Publications and literary activity:</p><p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli is the author of both scholarly and journalistic articles and works of poetry and prose. His works have been translated into Estonian, Georgian, Russian, Latvian, German, English and Turkic languages.</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>Author of more than 40 sociopolitical, historical and scientific-cultural articles;</li><li>author of 6 books and 1 monograph;</li><li>author of 4 scientific articles published in 2 scientific journals;</li><li>speaker and participant at more than 20 international symposia and conferences.</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Professional and academic activity:</p><ul class="awards-list"><li>Finno-Ugric and Turkic Peoples Research Center – chairman</li><li>University of Tartu (Estonia) – director of the Turkish Language Center</li><li>World Congress of Azerbaijanis – member of the Board, deputy chairman</li><li>Estonian-Azerbaijani Society – chairman</li><li>World Association of Azerbaijani Scientists – member of the Organizing Committee</li><li>Azerbaijan Writers&#x27; Union – member</li><li>Estonian Society of Academic Orientalists – member</li><li>Turkish Literature Foundation – honorary member</li></ul><p class="bio-section-title">Diplomatic and translation activity:</p><p class="bio">Khagani Gayibli has participated as a translator in high-level official meetings in Estonia and Turkey. He served as a special interpreter during official visits by the presidents, parliament speakers and ministers of Azerbaijan, Turkey and Estonia.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">In 2019, she obtained a Ph.D. degree in materials chemistry from the University of Orleans, France. Her research areas include structure-property relations of polymer materials, nanostructuring, preparation of functional materials and application of these fields in modern technologies. She collaborated with numerous international laboratories and conducted postdoctoral research at the French ENSAM/PIMM laboratory and the University of Delaware in the United States. Aynur Guliyeva also has industrial experience; she worked as a project manager for medicinal capsules for 2 years at Capsugel, which is part of the Lonza company. She currently works as an assistant professor at the university. Alongside her teaching, she has established a research group on "smart polymer materials" and conducts research in this field. She also performs various teaching and administrative duties at the university and mentors female scientists to support their professional development. Aynur Guliyeva has a number of scientific articles and has made oral and poster presentations at international conferences.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Reyhan Hasanova, who initially trained as a medical biologist, later earned two master's degrees in molecular biology and genetics in France. After that, she earned her doctorate in medical sciences on the topic of "biomarker research in colon cancer." She currently works as a research consultant on oncology and rare diseases in the Life Sciences department of Oracle in Paris, one of the world's largest companies. Through projects in this field, it is possible to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and cost of drugs and treatments, and to complete clinical trials by providing insights into how treatments are implemented in daily clinical practice. The results of these projects are published in international scientific journals and presented at conferences. The company she works for cooperates with up to 200 different pharmaceutical and biotechnological companies.</p>

Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles.json:482 Lev Eppelbaum — L039/profiles/27/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Honorary professor of Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University</p><p class="bio">Professor Lev Eppelbaum (Tel Aviv University, Department of Geophysics) is the author of approximately 460 scientific publications. These include 12 books, 18 book chapters, 194 peer-reviewed journal articles, 81 conference materials and 171 abstracts published by international scientific publishers (Kluwer Academic Publisher, Springer, Elsevier, Chapman and Hall, Institute of Physics (Great Britain)). Prof. Eppelbaum&#x27;s main research areas are geodynamics and tectonic reconstructions, applied and environmental geophysics, archaeological geophysics, and integrated analysis of geophysical, geological and related data.</p><p class="bio">He was elected head of scientific departments 26 times at international conferences. Professor Lev Eppelbaum is the editor-in-chief of the journal "Geology, Geophysics, and Earth Sciences" and a member of the editorial boards of such prestigious journals as "Positioning," "Open Petroleum Engineering Journal," "Archaeological Discovery," "Stratigraphy, Petroleum, Sedimentology, Geochemistry," "ANAS Transactions, Earth Sciences," "International Journal of Earthquake Engineering," "Discover Geoscience," "Academy Green Energy," "Contributions to Geosciences," "Geosciences," "Russian Journal of Physical Chemistry," and "World Journal of Physics." At the same time, he served as a guest editor for the journals "Advances in Geosciences," "Journal of Geophysics and Engineering," "Continent and Life Evolution," "Frontiers in Earth Sciences," "Geosciences (Switzerland)," &quot;Land&quot; and "Applied Sciences (Switzerland)."</p><p class="bio">Professor Lev Eppelbaum is a member of two international geophysical commissions: the "Rotation of the Earth" commission and "WebmedCentral Ecology Advisory Board."</p><p class="bio">In 2020, he was awarded the title of honorary professor of the Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University, and in 2023, he was elected a foreign member of the Georgian Academy of Sciences.</p><p class="bio">Professor Eppelbaum has received several awards; among them is the Christian Huygens medal of the European Geosciences Union (2019).</p><p class="bio">According to Google Scholar, his scholarly publications have been cited nearly 8,000 times.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">He is an expert in operations research and mathematical modeling. In 1981, he defended his Ph.D. thesis on applied mathematics at the Computing Center of the Academy of Sciences of the former USSR (Moscow). In 1991, he was awarded the diploma of Senior Researcher in the field of Application of Computing Techniques, Mathematical Modeling and Mathematical Methods in Research. From 1999 to 2024, he taught more than 25 different Ph.D., master&#x27;s and bachelor&#x27;s courses at York and Toronto Universities in Canada. More than 25 articles have been published in various international scientific journals. He is the author of a textbook and a book. He gave presentations at 12 international scientific conferences held in the USA, Canada, Australia, Italy, China and Russia. He gave speeches at the scientific seminars of the Institute of Cybernetics of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences, Fields Institute of Mathematical Research of Canada, Toronto and York Universities and ADA University. He was a member of the program committees of INFOCOMP 2013 (Lisbon, Portugal) and INFOCOMP 2015 (Brussels, Belgium) international conferences. His work is referenced in two high school textbooks. In 2013, he was awarded the Excellence in Teaching Award by the Faculty of Science at the University of York – an award given to him for teaching excellence and service to the faculty. Together with Professor Robert G. Burns, he translated the works of N. N. Moiseyev, a former academician of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR, &quot;Man and the Noosphere&quot; and &quot;How Far Tomorrow is&quot; into English. The translation of the latter book was published by Birkhauser publishing house in 2022.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Rovshan Ibrahimov worked as a professor in the field of international relations and energy policy at various universities in Azerbaijan, Turkey, Germany, Poland, Kazakhstan and South Korea, and currently works as a professor at Hankuk University of Foreign Languages (HUFS) and Khazar University.</p><p class="bio">He was honored for his activities in the field of foreign policy analysis, international relations and diaspora at the Center for Strategic Studies under the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">Professor R. He is distinguished by his active participation in international strategic discussions.</p><p class="bio">At the same time, he worked as the head of the Department of International Relations, vice-rector for International Relations and head of the department at Qafqaz University.</p><p class="bio">The scientist is a member of the editorial boards of international scientific journals and makes scientific contributions to various think tanks. <p class="bio bio-lead">A teacher of Azerbaijani language and literature at the Faculty of Literature of Cairo University, a scientific leader at the department of Oriental languages and Arabic, president of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Peoples&#x27; Friendship Academy, adviser on foreign relations of the General Secretariat of the World Fatwa Organizations, chairman of the Board of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Friendship Society, head of the Azerbaijani Diaspora in Egypt.</p><p class="bio">Since the 2016–2017 academic year, he has been working as a teacher of the Azerbaijani language at the Faculty of Literature of Cairo University, Egypt, and as a scientific supervisor at the department of Oriental Languages and Arabic Language of the faculty. Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles.json:703 Akif Suleymanov — L059, L246/profiles/40/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Akif Suleymanov is a well-known lawyer and scientist in the field of constitutional law and public administration. He has the degrees of Doctor of Philosophy in Law (Ph.D.) and Doctor of Legal Sciences. His research is mainly devoted to theoretical and practical aspects of interaction between the President of Kazakhstan and the Constitutional Council and public control over executive authorities.</p><p class="bio">Professor Suleymanov, who has more than twenty years of academic experience, worked in pedagogical and administrative positions in a number of prestigious higher education institutions of Kazakhstan: Academy of Economics and Law, National Pedagogical University named after Abay, Narkhoz University and Turan University, where he currently works.</p><p class="bio">He is the author or co-author of 2 textbooks and 8 textbooks on public administration, constitutionalism, public control, human and civil rights. More than 100 scientific articles have been published as a result of his research on constitutional law, public control, gender policy and the political system of Kazakhstan. 6 of these articles are published in prestigious international scientific journals indexed in "Scopus." Also, his scientific writings were published in journals approved by the Higher Attestation Commissions of Kazakhstan and CIS countries, as well as in prestigious scientific publications of countries both nearby and farther afield.</p><p class="bio">In addition to his scientific activities, Professor Suleymanov, who actively participates in the field of public administration, is a member of the expert and advisory councils of the People&#x27;s Assembly of Kazakhstan, the Constitutional Court and the Fund for the Development of Parliamentarianism.</p><p class="bio">For his scientific achievements and public services, he was awarded the Birlik gold medal, as well as honorary decrees of the Ministry of Justice and Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In addition, he works as a member of the editorial boards of a number of scientific journals in the field of law in Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead"></p><p class="bio">Professor Arzu Gurbanova gave lectures on "English language stylistics," "English grammar," "History of England," &quot;Practical phonetics of the English language&quot; and other subjects. She is the author of the textbooks "English Grammar," "English Phonetics," &quot;English Stylistics&quot; and the monograph "Pedagogical conditions for increasing the independent work of high school students in the English language class."</p><p class="bio">She is the author of more than 250 scientific articles in local and foreign publications, including journals indexed in the &quot;Scopus&quot; database. Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles.json:754 Akif Alaferdov — L063/profiles/43/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Akif Alaferdov is a well-known traumatologist, a descendant of Azerbaijanis who were deported to Kyrgyzstan in 1933.</p><p class="bio">Dr. Akif made important contributions to the methodology of surgical treatment of femoral neck fractures. McMurray received a patent for the invention of the &quot;detachable fixator&quot; used in surgery. Akif Alaferdov is the author of a monograph, more than 35 scientific articles, 3 methodological resources and more than 20 effective recommendations on the treatment of femoral neck fractures with surgical intervention.</p><p class="bio">During his professional career, Alaferdov was the head of the complex trauma department at the National Hospital of the Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic and a member of the Special Scientific Council of the Kyrgyz State Medical Institute. He has performed thousands of operations and trained highly qualified specialists. His contributions in this field were recognized by the President of the Kyrgyz Republic with an Honorary Order in 1997, and in 2003 he was awarded the title of "Honored Doctor."</p><p class="bio">In addition to his achievements in the field of medicine, Alaferdov was also engaged in social and cultural activities. From 1997 to 2013, he was the chairman of the &quot;Azeri&quot; Public Union of Azerbaijanis living in Kyrgyzstan. Under his leadership, Sunday schools in the Azerbaijani language were opened, mosques were built, and a folklore ensemble called &quot;Stars&quot; was created. He took part in many events to strengthen the relations between Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan and organized &quot;Bishkek-Baku&quot; telebridges for many years with the participation of deputies, writers, public figures and diaspora representatives from both sides.</p><p class="bio">For his long-term public activity, Akif Alaferdov was awarded the &quot;Dank&quot; state award in 2008, as well as the medal &quot;For service in Diaspora activity&quot; from the State Committee for Work with the Diaspora of the Republic of Azerbaijan. In 2023, he was awarded the Order of &quot;Friend&quot; by the President of Kyrgyzstan for his contributions to strengthening peace, friendship and cooperation between nations. He was awarded the &quot;Chingiz Aytmatov&quot; medal for his achievements in the fields of culture, science, literature and social activities.</p><p class="bio">He was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal in 2026 by order of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mr. Ilham Aliyev for his services in the field of strengthening friendship between peoples and the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</p><div class="card-resources"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="akif-alaferdov-media.html">Additional resources <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></a></div>

Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles.json:806 Aladdin Allahverdiyev — L269/profiles/46/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">He completed his undergraduate and postgraduate studies at the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of the Moscow State University named after M. V. Lomonosov.</p><p class="bio">He is a well-known Soviet, Russian and Azerbaijani scientist who develops mathematical models and methods for studying wave and oscillation processes in the creation of piezoelectric devices and apparatus. These are used in research on the world ocean and outer space, marine seismic exploration, and the electronics, defense and medical industries.</p><p class="bio">For the first time, he managed to solve the problem of determining the optimal shape of piezoelectric elements, which has not been solved for many years, meets the physical properties required in the dynamic mode, and has a minimum mass or volume. The solution to this problem made it possible to determine the location and individual characteristics of objects moving under water in the world ocean, the information of interest to experts in relevant scientific fields was recorded from space objects - artificial satellites and spaceships, and the creation of receiver-transmitter devices to transmit and receive the Flight Control Center. For the first time, he successfully applied the method of solving two- and three-dimensional dynamic problems, which are important in the creation of piezoelectric devices used in military equipment. The existence of the &quot;edge effect&quot; in disk-shaped piezoceramic membranes was also theoretically discovered by him for the first time. The piezoceramic actuator, developed jointly with the co-authors, was successfully used to solve the problem of creating an artificial heart. He is the author of more than 450 open and closed (confidential) scientific works, inventions, monographs, higher education textbooks, and a number of scientific articles on the problems of organizing higher professional education and educational technologies. Under his scientific guidance, 7 graduate students, including 3 Azerbaijanis, defended their candidate dissertations. In general, based on the obtained scientific results, he delivered more than 60 presentations, including 12 commissioned plenary presentations, at 30 international and general congresses, conferences and symposia.</p><p class="bio">Some of the prizes and awards received by Professor Aladdin Allahverdiyev for his achievements in the fields of science, technology and education:</p><p class="bio">Medal named after the Hero of Socialist Labor of the Russian Cosmonautics Federation, lieutenant general, Lenin Prize laureate, professor, chairman of the State Commission on Space Programs Georgy Alexandrovich Tyulin;</p><p class="bio">Medal named after Khalil Ahmadovich Rakhmatulin, Hero of Socialist Labor of the National Committee for Theoretical and Applied Mechanics of the Russian Academy of Sciences, academician, laureate of four Orders of Lenin, several State Prizes;</p><p class="bio">the title &quot;Honored worker of higher vocational education of the Russian Federation&quot;;</p><p class="bio">Three times—in 1975, 1977 and 1980—badges of &quot;The winner of the race of socialism&quot; established by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, the former Council of Ministers of the USSR, the Central Committee of Trade Unions, the Central Committee of the All-Union Labor Party;</p><p class="bio">&quot;850th anniversary of Moscow&quot; state medal;</p><p class="bio">Jubilee medal &quot;250th anniversary of MSU named after M.V. Lomonosov&quot;;</p><p class="bio">Gold medal of the All-Russian Exhibition Center;</p><p class="bio">diploma of the winner of the review-competition of the Presidium of the Central Office of the All-Union Scientific Medical-Technical Society;</p><p class="bio">Laureate titles and cash prizes for 4 consecutive years (2001–2004) in the "Moscow Grant" competition established by the Moscow Government for science and technology in the field of education;</p><p class="bio">Numerous honorary decrees, diplomas, certificates, and other honors from the Russian Federation, several foreign countries, and many international institutions and organizations.</p>

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Azer Jafar oglu Abdullayev, a doctor of medical sciences, traumatologist-orthopedic surgeon, and inventor, is a medical scientist with extensive scientific and practical experience in the field of traumatology and orthopedics. He has worked as a teacher, assistant and associate professor at Azerbaijan Medical University for many years, and since 2004 he has been the head of the Orthopedic Department and consultant surgeon at King Fahad and Sabya Hospitals located in Gizan, Saudi Arabia.</p><p class="bio">Abdullayev, who was born in 1955 in Sharur, Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, entered the Faculty of Medicine and Prevention of Azerbaijan Medical University in 1972, and in 1979 he completed the surgery internship. In 1989, he was awarded the degree of doctor of philosophy in medicine, and in 2012, he was awarded the degree of doctor of medical sciences.</p><p class="bio">His research is marked by considerable inventiveness. He is the author of 6 inventions—including an external fixation device, a compression pin and a healing ointment—that are widely used in medical practice, known by such names as "Abdullayev apparatus," &quot;Abdullayev stick&quot; and "Abdullayev ointment." These inventions have been used in the treatment of thousands of patients and have given positive results.</p><p class="bio">Professor Abdullayev&#x27;s research and teaching activities are also extensive: he is the author of more than 70 scientific articles and 2 teaching methodology resources, and the owner of 6 invention patents. His work made significant contributions to the development of practical health care, along with important scientific innovations in the field of traumatology and orthopedics.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Elvin Efendi is an economist with extensive international experience in economics and development. Currently, he works as the head of strategy and research in the Strategic department of the Islamic Private Sector Development Corporation (ICD), a part of the Islamic Development Bank Group. In this role, he leads the development of corporate and country strategies, the management of economic research and policy documents, the publication of leading reports, and the creation of private sector development initiatives in member countries.</p><p class="bio">Before that, Elvin Efendi worked in important positions in the field of economic analysis and policy planning in institutions such as the Central Bank of Azerbaijan, the World Bank and the Ministry of Economic Development of the Republic of Azerbaijan. He studied at the University of London, Michigan State University and Baku State University, and received a Ph.D. in economics.</p><p class="bio">Elvin Efendi has authored more than 20 peer-reviewed scientific articles in academic journals, as well as more than 25 research documents (working papers). He gave presentations at more than 10 international scientific conferences and participated in events held in more than 15 countries. For the first time, he developed the "Private Sector Development Index of Islamic Countries," which evaluates the level of development of the private sector in Islamic countries, and this academic innovation was published in a prestigious scientific journal. He has taught more than 300 graduate and undergraduate students economic development, macroeconomics, microeconomics, and econometrics at various universities, including Dar Al Hekma University. He also taught at Khazar University and UNEC.</p><p class="bio">Elvin Efendi has extensive research experience in economic policy, development economics, entrepreneurship and social capital. He was a member of the editorial boards of a number of prestigious academic journals, performed extensive scientific and organizational activities as a leader of and participant in various international projects, and was awarded various prizes and scholarships.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Lecturer in the Department of Contemporary Turkish Dialects and Literature</p><p class="bio">Her scientific work focuses on modern Azerbaijani literature, dialectology, Ashiq literature and Azerbaijani folklore. She teaches Azerbaijani literature, the history of Azerbaijani literary criticism and the history of the Azerbaijani literary language. Under her supervision, 10 master&#x27;s dissertations on Azerbaijani literature were defended in Kars, Turkey.</p><p class="bio">She has presented at more than 30 international scientific conferences; most of these papers were published in scholarly volumes. Her articles have appeared in more than 10 international books and more than 30 international journals. She has edited 10 scholarly books and authored 4 books on Azerbaijani language and literature. <p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Hajali Najafoglu received his higher education in chemistry at Azerbaijan State University, and then received his doctorate in inorganic chemistry at the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences. His multifaceted scientific and pedagogical activity played an important role in the development of regional and international cooperation in the field of chemistry. <p class="bio bio-lead">Professor Ismixhan Bayramoglu specializes in probability theory, statistics and stochastic processes. His research interests include mathematics, probability and statistics, and reliability engineering. Professor Bayramov has supervised more than 17 Ph.D. graduates, many of whom are currently pursuing academic careers at universities internationally. He has published more than 120 scientific articles in international journals with a high impact factor, 75 of which have been published in journals indexed in SCI and SCI Expanded. At the same time, he is the author of three international books in the field of probability and statistics. A member of the editorial boards of several international journals, the scientist also serves as the editor-in-chief of the "Statistics" journal.</p><p class="bio">His research is documented on major scholarly platforms such as "Web of Science," &quot;ORCID&quot; and "Google Scholar." He participated as an invited speaker in numerous international conferences, which is an indicator of his international reputation in his field.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Aytekin Huseynli is an international specialist in social policy, social work, child and family welfare. Dr. Huseynli is an assistant professor at the University of Washington. Her applied research focuses on the formulation of social policies, especially the improvement of family and child welfare. Aytekin Huseynli also explores strategies and ways to channel natural resource revenues into social development in countries rich in oil, gas and minerals. Aytekin Huseynli&#x27;s doctoral dissertation led to the creation of the National Children&#x27;s Fund state program, which covers 7 million children in Kazakhstan and is financed by a portion of the oil and gas wealth.</p><p class="bio">She is the author of 3 chapters in 3 books in the field of social policy, social work and social development, 15 scientific articles in 15 international scientific journals, and more than 20 publications, and she is a member of the editorial boards of 2 scientific journals in the field of social development, social policy and social work. She gave presentations at more than 20 international scientific conferences and received 2 international awards for her scientific work. She was the scientific supervisor of more than 10 students. Aytekin Huseynli teaches social research, statistics, program evaluation and social policy. Currently, she is the head of several research projects.</p><p class="bio">A pioneer in her field, Aytekin Huseynli is one of the first professional social workers who received an education in the field of social work in the post-Soviet region and is one of the founders of the social work profession and education in Azerbaijan. Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-01.json:1 Messoud Efendiyev — L264, L265/profiles/7/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">Head of the &quot;Dynamic Systems&quot; Department at the &quot;Helmholtz&quot; Scientific Research Center, Munich, Germany</p><p class="bio">Rector&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor at Marmara University, Istanbul, Turkey</p><p class="bio">Professor Masud Efendiyev is the first Azerbaijani scientist living abroad, known both for the prestigious international awards he won and the international conferences organized in his honor. Although he has been living and working in Germany for more than 35 years, he remains a citizen of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Contributions to nonlinear analysis and mathematical physics</p><p class="bio">He created a new theory of topological invariants for the global solution of nonlinear equations.</p><p class="bio">These invariants play an important role in the analysis of qualitative changes (local and global bifurcation) of nonlinear systems.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Mathematical modeling</p><p class="bio">He conducted fundamental research on mathematical modeling of problems encountered in the fields of biology, medicine, ecology, mechanics and physics.</p><p class="bio">He created new classes of attractors of dynamic systems according to evolution equations and made an important contribution to their systematic study.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international scientific journals</p><p class="bio">He is a member of the editorial boards of more than ten leading international journals.</p><p class="bio">He is the editor-in-chief of "International Journal of Biomathematics and Biostatistics."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Scientific publications</p><p class="bio">He is the author of 8 books published in Japan, Germany, the USA, Canada and Switzerland.</p><p class="bio">He has written more than 200 scientific articles and collaborated with co-authors from 15 countries.</p><p class="bio-section-title">Activities in international universities</p><p class="bio">In 2018, he lectured for 6 months at the University of Toronto and the Fields Institute as a &quot;Dean&#x27;s Distinguished Visiting Professor&quot; and played an important role in the implementation of the thematic program "Emerging Challenges in Mathematical Biology."</p><p class="bio">In 2019, he was invited to the University of Waterloo as a "James D. Murray Distinguished Visiting Professor."</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and honors</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>In 1991, he was the first Azerbaijani scientist to win the &quot;Alexander von Humboldt&quot; award established by the German government.</li><li>In 2005, he was awarded the prestigious &quot;Japan Society for the Promotion of Science - JSPS&quot; award.</li><li>In 2007, he won the prestigious &quot;Otto Monsted&quot; award of the Danish government. He is the first Azerbaijani scientist to win these awards.</li><li>In 2022, he was awarded the honorary title of Honored Scientist by the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliyev.</li><li>In 2023, he was awarded the Life Achievement Award of the Fields Institute.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">International conferences and recognition</p><p class="bio">The 60th anniversary of teacher Masud was celebrated in Germany (Munich), and the 70th anniversary was celebrated in Baku (at the state level) with international scientific conferences.</p><p class="bio">75 leading scientists from 25 countries participated in the conference held in Munich.</p><p class="bio">55 famous scientists from 23 countries participated in the conference held in Baku.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">With the support of the "2007–2015 State Program for the Education of Azerbaijani Youth in Foreign Countries," he completed his doctorate with honors at the Mannheim Medical Faculty of Heidelberg University. His main research focus is the creation of complex 3D cell cultures in vitro for the study of tumor diseases and the investigation of the effect of tumor cells on drugs in those cultures through various biomarkers. The findings of this research have been published in two peer-reviewed articles so far. The most recent article was well received by the journal &quot;Frontiers in Oncology&quot; and republished in a special issue. In addition, the program he wrote for the segmentation of large-volume confocal microscopic images is currently in the process of being registered as an invention. As a group leader, he supervises 2 master's students and 1 doctoral student.</p>

Deployment/i18n/scientists-profiles/chunk-01.json:1 Khadija Zeynalova — L273, L019/profiles/14/bio_html_en

Before

<p class="bio bio-lead">She is the first Azerbaijani composer and musicologist to be awarded a doctoral scholarship by the prestigious &quot;Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung&quot; in Germany. In addition, she is a recipient of the &quot;DAAD&quot; scholarship award, the scholarship award of the German Ministry of Culture of North Rhine-Westphalia, the scholarship award of the &quot;GVL&quot; Foundation, the scholarship awards of the &quot;GEMA&quot; foundation and the &quot;Musikfonds&quot; foundation.</p><p class="bio">In 2020, Khadija Zeynalova was awarded the Letter of Appreciation of the Republic of Azerbaijan "for her special activity in Diaspora building."</p><p class="bio">In 2021, she was awarded the &quot;880th anniversary of Nizamin&quot; medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">In 2021, in the Year of Nizami and Yunus Emre, she was awarded a Certificate of Appreciation for her participation as a composer in the &quot;Masterpieces of the Turkish World&quot; project organized by TURKSOY.</p><p class="bio">In 2022, at the 5th Congress of the World Azerbaijanis held in Shusha, she was awarded the medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan "For Service in Diaspora Activity."</p><p class="bio">In 2024, as the first Azerbaijani composer in Germany, she was awarded the nomination &quot;Composer and Artist of the Year&quot; by the German Ministry of Culture and "Klosterlandschaft OWL."</p><p class="bio">Khadija Zeynalova was awarded the Honorary Decree for her contribution to the promotion of Azerbaijani musical culture in the world as a composer at the 1st Forum of Azerbaijani Culture Ambassadors held in Antalya on November 3–5, 2025.</p><p class="bio">She is the author of a doctoral dissertation on musicology and art studies, 1 scientific book published in Germany in the field of composition, 35 books published in Azerbaijan, Holland, Japan, England and Germany, and 10 articles published in scientific journals. She has given research presentations as a composer and musicologist at 20 international scientific conferences, and is the author and artistic director of about 20 different international projects, festivals, and concerts.</p><p class="bio">She was awarded the &quot;Progress&quot; medal in 2026 by the Decree of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mr. Ilham Aliyev for her services in the field of strengthening friendship between peoples and the development of the Azerbaijani diaspora.</p>

<p class="bio bio-lead">Azerbaijan ETN Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnologies in Baku, group leader and laboratory manager</p><p class="bio-section-title">Research areas:</p><p class="bio">Prof. Dr. Garib Murshudov is one of the world&#x27;s leading scientists in the field of molecular biology, crystallography and structural biology. His main research directions are as follows:</p><p class="bio">Macromolecular crystallography and structural biology (analysis of three-dimensional structures of proteins and nucleic acids).</p><p class="bio">Cryo-electron microscopy (Cryo-EM) and bioinformatics (molecular modeling, structural analysis and data processing).</p><p class="bio">Statistical and mathematical modeling (application of maximum likelihood and Bayesian statistical methods in biological systems).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Academic and professional experience:</p><p class="bio">He works as a group leader at the MRC Molecular Biology Laboratory (Cambridge, Great Britain) and as a laboratory manager at the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnology of the Ministry of Science and Education of Azerbaijan (Baku).</p><p class="bio">He worked in prestigious research institutes and universities in Great Britain, Russia and Azerbaijan.</p><p class="bio">He is the main author of the software that constructs atomic models of macromolecules using experiments, renders them transparent and checks them statistically (REFMAC, BALBES, Servalcat, AceDRG, etc.).</p><p class="bio-section-title">Awards and recognition:</p><div class="awards-block"><ul class="awards-list"><li>He was awarded the honorary title of &quot;Honored Scientist&quot; of the Republic of Azerbaijan.</li><li>Won the Wellcome Trust Senior Fellowship—the UK's most prestigious fellowship in biology</li><li>Member of the European Molecular Biology Organization (EMBO).</li><li>Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society of Great Britain.</li><li>Member of the CCP4 executive committee – this committee brings together leading international researchers in the field of computational structural biology.</li></ul></div><p class="bio-section-title">Publications and scientific contributions:</p><p class="bio">He is the author of more than 120 high-impact scientific articles, including in prestigious journals such as Nature, Science, PNAS and Acta Crystallographica.</p><p class="bio">He was a leading researcher in the development of innovative software (REFMAC5, SERVALCAT, EMDA, BALBES, AceDRG) for the analysis and modeling of molecular structures.</p><p class="bio">He regularly participates in international symposia and conferences and organizes scientific seminars in different countries (Great Britain, Japan, China, USA, Brazil, India, etc.).</p>
